bao_arborist.name: Climbing
bao_arborist.summary: Climbs sheer surfaces with a Climbing throw per 100' (fall on failure, 1d6 per 10'); -5 at half combat speed, -10 at full. 6+ at 1st, improving.

bao_arborist.name: Dendromancy
bao_arborist.summary: Leads dendromantic rituals and cultivates sacred trees: 5gp cultivation/day and ritual throw 16+ at 1st, both improving with level.

bao_arborist.name: Forest Gardening
bao_arborist.summary: Counts as a skilled laborer (2sp/day construction); can force march 1 day + 1 per CON bonus without penalty. Like Labor proficiency.

bao_arborist.name: Natural Medicine
bao_arborist.summary: Forages/identifies healing herbs as 1 rank of Naturalism (+4 if already proficient), uses them as Healing; 1 turn to make potent herbs (+1 effect, 24 hrs).

bao_arborist.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_arborist.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_arborist.name: Connection to Nature
bao_arborist.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_arborist.name: Elf Tongues
bao_arborist.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_arborist.name: Natural Magic
bao_arborist.summary: Performs minor natural cantrips (calm animals, clean odors, soothe stings, warm rooms), 1 turn each; or learns arcane cantrips if those rules are used.

bao_arborist.name: Green Sense
bao_arborist.summary: While stationary, senses direction/distance to nearest named animal or plant type within 180' (blocked by lead/gold). +4 to Naturalism herb-finding and Hunting.

bao_arborist.name: Forest Management
bao_arborist.summary: Spending 20 days/month managing a fastness's forests (as ruler or chief arborist) adds 1gp land revenue per peasant family.

bao_arborist.name: Green Growth
bao_arborist.summary: Casts plant growth once per day (1 turn); can sustain a number of plant growths equal to class level.

bao_arborist.name: Enchanted Forest
bao_arborist.summary: Casts forest enchantment once per week (1 turn); can sustain a number equal to class level (about 2 acres per level).

bao_arborist.name: Green Tongue
bao_arborist.summary: Speak with plants at will in his territory; managing forests needs only ancillary activity; +4 to forage/hunt/track there; army +2 recon. Counts as 2 powers.

bao_arborist.name: Wood Waking
bao_arborist.summary: Once/day, full-round action: awakens a tree within 60' (mature 45'+ tree acts as a galdrtre; smaller ~1 HD per 6') that obeys orders for 12 turns.

bao_arborist.name: Fastness
bao_arborist.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st level elven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay normal rates.

bao_arborist.name: Arboreal Authority
bao_arborist.summary: Concentrating: dominates plants in 20' area within 30' (sapient <2 HD save vs Spells); creatures there save vs Paralysis or restrained, 1d4 P + 1d4 Po/round.

bao_arborist.name: Green Ways
bao_arborist.summary: Steps into a large hollow tree and, after 10 rounds, emerges from another within 96 miles; once per hour, max 20 stone carried.

bao_arborist.name: Dendromantic Insight
bao_arborist.summary: Can create new dendromantic rituals (Judge sets tier; costs equal ritual base cost; requires a dendromancy throw; natural 20 lets others learn it).

bao_arborist.name: Dendromantic Mastery
bao_arborist.summary: Adds fastness's current morale (if positive) to dendromancy throws; rituals with unmet prerequisites succeed if he and one other participant succeed.

bao_courtier.name: Classical Education
bao_courtier.summary: Decipher runes, recall history, identify artifacts/monster parts on 18+ (-1 per level); identifies magic items as a 5th level mage. Like Loremastery.

bao_courtier.name: Diplomacy
bao_courtier.summary: +1 to all reaction rolls when parleying with intelligent creatures. Like Diplomacy proficiency.

bao_courtier.name: Elven Glamour
bao_courtier.summary: +1 to reaction rolls to impress/intimidate; a total of 12+ leaves subjects bewitched while in your presence. Not vs. elven glamour. Like Mystic Aura.

bao_courtier.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_courtier.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack table).

bao_courtier.name: Gift-Giving
bao_courtier.summary: +1/+2/+3 reaction bonus for a gift worth a day's/week's/month's pay of the target; never charged with bribery. Like Bribery proficiency.

bao_courtier.name: Inspire Courage
bao_courtier.summary: 1 round of oration inspires up to 30 allies within 50' for 1 turn: +1 attack, AC, morale, and saves vs fear. Once/day per level; not once combat is joined.

bao_courtier.name: Performance
bao_courtier.summary: Could earn 10gp/month performing; identifies famous performers, works, and songs on 11+. One rank of Performance proficiency.

bao_courtier.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_courtier.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_courtier.name: Connection to Nature
bao_courtier.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_courtier.name: Elf Tongues
bao_courtier.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_courtier.name: Arcane Magic
bao_courtier.summary: Casts arcane spells per the Courtier Spell Progression (slower caster level); repertoire = spells listed + INT bonus; can cast in armor.

bao_courtier.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_courtier.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_courtier.name: Fastness
bao_courtier.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st level elven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay normal rates.

bao_courtier.name: Major Magical Research
bao_courtier.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs. (Only beyond normal max level 11.)

bao_druid.name: Arcane Magic
bao_druid.summary: Casts arcane spells per the Druid Arcane Spell Progression; studious caster with repertoire = spells listed + INT bonus.

bao_druid.name: Divine Magic
bao_druid.summary: Casts divine spells per the Divine Spell Progression, learned studiously like arcane spells with a separate divine repertoire.

bao_druid.name: Secrets of the Sect
bao_druid.summary: Chooses a sect (celestial, telluric, hypogean) granting powers at 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11; member of its hierarchy; can gain congregants; 1 rank of Theology.

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Secrets of the Radiant Arts
bao_druid.summary: Rebukes undead as a crusader of half level; -2 to targets' Paralysis saves; protection spells and research at +2 caster levels (+2 throw, +10% rate).

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Friend of Birds and Beasts
bao_druid.summary: Identifies flora/fauna on 11+; understands animals; +2 reactions with normal animals; takes and trains animal henchmen without Animal Training.

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Kin of the Creeping and Crawling
bao_druid.summary: Identifies vermin on 11+; understands crawling vermin (normal and giant); +2 reactions with them; takes and trains them as henchmen.

bao_druid.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_druid.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_druid.name: Connection to Nature
bao_druid.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_druid.name: Elf Tongues
bao_druid.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_druid.name: Code of Behavior
bao_druid.summary: Must obey his sect's code; violations bring Judge-set penalties (curses, lost spells/powers) until atoned. Has 2 daily study requirements (arcane + divine).

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Code of Behavior
bao_druid.summary: White robes and redwood staff/sprig; no reaped grain or slain meat; hymns at dawn and dusk; no chaotic magic or death/necromantic spells; vigil every 7th night.

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Code of Behavior
bao_druid.summary: Green/brown robes, oak staff or mistletoe; uncut hair; raw food; prays 4x/day; spares non-chaotic beasts; no metal armor/jewelry; tithes 10% income to forests.

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Code of Behavior
bao_druid.summary: Black robes, yew staff/sprig, veiled by day; eats only fermented food, meat, fungi, roots; blood libations; won't heal mortal wounds or raise dead; sacrifices.

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Astrology
bao_druid.summary: Gains one rank of Knowledge (astrology) proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Nature Lore
bao_druid.summary: Gains one rank of Naturalism proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Bloodletting
bao_druid.summary: Gains one rank of Healing proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_druid.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_druid.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Aerial Dispatch
bao_druid.summary: Can cast avian messenger once per day.

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Wild Semblance
bao_druid.summary: Can cast skinchange once per day.

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Judgment of the Dead
bao_druid.summary: Can cast bestow curse once per day.

bao_druid.name: Esoteric Contemplation
bao_druid.summary: One hour of meditation regains one expended spell; max once per spell level per day (one per level per magic type with Contemplation).

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Auspicy
bao_druid.summary: Takes auspices from bird flight for a divination-like omen about the coming week: 4+ for wild birds, or 16+ minus 1 per caged bird released.

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Sortilege
bao_druid.summary: Casts lots for a divination-like portent about the coming week: unique carved lots (1 hour) on 4+, or standard lots (1 turn) on 16+ minus caster level.

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Anthropomancy
bao_druid.summary: Reads death throes for a divination-like portent about the coming week: sacrificial victims on 4+, battlefield casualties on 17+ minus the victim's HD.

bao_druid.name: Major Magical Research
bao_druid.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_druid.name: Nemeton
bao_druid.summary: With a 15,000gp+ nemeton, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd level and 2d6 0th level apprentices within 1d3 months; they assist magic research for room and board.

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Knowledge of the Cosmos
bao_druid.summary: Studies the night sky instead of spellbooks; sky counts as a 10,000gp library per astrology rank; adds astrology ranks to experimentation breakthroughs.

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Warden of the Wild
bao_druid.summary: Bestial monstrosities and vermin count as animals for Friend of Birds and Beasts and for bewitch/dominate/infuriate/speak with beasts.

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Supper of Worms
bao_druid.summary: Touching a corpse for 9 rounds then eating the grubs absorbs its full special component value as arcane or divine power, storable indefinitely.

bao_druid.name: Supreme Magical Research
bao_druid.summary: Can learn/cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells, craft constructs, create crossbreeds; if chaotic, create necromantic servants and become undead.

bao_druid.name: Celestial: Cycle of the Heavens
bao_druid.summary: Ancillary activity each day controls weather (as summon weather) over his domain (up to 16 hexes) or 1 hex; 21+ days/month adjusts land value by 1gp.

bao_druid.name: Telluric: Congregation of the Green
bao_druid.summary: As ruler or chaplain of an elven domain, gains weekly divine power equal to 10% of each forest hex's land revenue (1 day dedicated activity/week).

bao_druid.name: Hypogean: Root of All Evil
bao_druid.summary: Crossbreeds plants with undead at half material and research cost; crossbreeds get +4 loyalty but turn hostile if he breaks his code.

bao_nightblade.name: Acrobatics
bao_nightblade.summary: +2 to saves where agility helps; adds level to DEX for jumping; can tumble past an engaged foe on a throw (18+ at 1st, improving). Like Acrobatics.

bao_nightblade.name: Backstabbing
bao_nightblade.summary: Backstab vulnerable foes in melee or at short missile range: +4 to hit and +1 damage die per 4 levels.

bao_nightblade.name: Climbing
bao_nightblade.summary: Climbs sheer surfaces with a Climbing throw per 100' (fall on failure, 1d6 per 10'); -5 at half combat speed, -10 at full. 6+ at 1st, improving.

bao_nightblade.name: Hiding
bao_nightblade.summary: Hides as a combat action in cover, dim light, or darkness (19+ at 1st, improving); foes -2 to surprise while he is stationary and concealed.

bao_nightblade.name: Shadowy Senses
bao_nightblade.summary: When moving at combat or exploration speed, 'sees' as if carrying a 30' radius dim light; cannot read or discern colors, faces, or images.

bao_nightblade.name: Sneaking
bao_nightblade.summary: Moves silently at up to half combat speed (17+ at 1st, improving; -5 faster, -10 running); foes -2 to surprise when he is out of sight.

bao_nightblade.name: Streetwise
bao_nightblade.summary: May belong to an assassins' guild; identifies home criminal signs/slang automatically, others on 11+. One rank of Streetwise proficiency.

bao_nightblade.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_nightblade.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_nightblade.name: Connection to Nature
bao_nightblade.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_nightblade.name: Elf Tongues
bao_nightblade.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_nightblade.name: Arcane Magic
bao_nightblade.summary: Casts arcane spells per the Nightblade Spell Progression (slower caster level); repertoire = spells listed + INT bonus; can cast in light armor.

bao_nightblade.name: Quiet Magic
bao_nightblade.summary: Casts with minimal words and gestures: a hear noise throw is needed to notice; must be fully bound and gagged to prevent casting.

bao_nightblade.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_nightblade.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_nightblade.name: Hideout
bao_nightblade.summary: With a 5,000gp+ hideout, attracts 2d6 1st level elven nightblades within 1d4 weeks (paid as henchmen; at least one is a rival's spy).

bao_nightblade.name: Major Magical Research
bao_nightblade.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs. (Only beyond normal max level 11.)

bao_nightblade.name: Silent Sorcery
bao_nightblade.summary: While stationary and sneaking, casts spells with no sound at all, without ending the sneaking condition. (Only beyond normal max level 11.)

bao_purveyor.name: Diplomacy
bao_purveyor.summary: +1 to all reaction rolls when parleying with intelligent creatures. Like Diplomacy proficiency.

bao_purveyor.name: Gift-Giving
bao_purveyor.summary: +1/+2/+3 reaction bonus for a gift worth a day's/week's/month's pay of the target; never charged with bribery. Like Bribery proficiency.

bao_purveyor.name: Humanoid Resources
bao_purveyor.summary: +1 reaction on hiring offers of 1+ year; no penalty after party's failed hires; hirelings skip loyalty rolls on level-up absent calamities.

bao_purveyor.name: Listening
bao_purveyor.summary: One round of listening (once per turn if moving); Judge rolls secretly vs Listening throw (10+ at 1st, improving by level).

bao_purveyor.name: Mercantile Network
bao_purveyor.summary: In previously visited markets, treat the market as one class larger or take +1 market impact (not for passive investments).

bao_purveyor.name: Salesmanship
bao_purveyor.summary: Sells items for 10% over list (as Bargaining); +2 on reaction rolls to raise sale prices. Does not stack with Bargaining.

bao_purveyor.name: Specialty Merchandiser
bao_purveyor.summary: Chooses a specialty merchandise: identifies it on 7+, adds half level to market impact, shifts sale price one step, +1 passive investment.

bao_purveyor.name: Treachery
bao_purveyor.summary: After a Friendly reaction via Diplomacy/Gift-Giving, can attack to force all within 30' to roll surprise at -3. Not vs dwarves or rival treacherous negotiators.

bao_purveyor.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_purveyor.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_purveyor.name: Connection to Nature
bao_purveyor.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_purveyor.name: Elf Tongues
bao_purveyor.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_purveyor.name: Patient Negotiation
bao_purveyor.summary: Cumulative +1 on each repeated spot-price negotiation roll or influence-over-time attempt until resolved. Doesn't stack with Mystic Aura.

bao_purveyor.name: Trade Concessions
bao_purveyor.summary: No concessions needed for grudging agreement on specialty goods; reduces tariffs on them by class level (negative tariff becomes a subsidy).

bao_purveyor.name: Specialty Merchandiser
bao_purveyor.summary: Gains a second specialty merchandise with all the same benefits.

bao_purveyor.name: Factorage
bao_purveyor.summary: Delegates henchmen as factors in markets he has traded in, using his network, specialties, and concessions; max one factor per market per month.

bao_purveyor.name: Guildhouse
bao_purveyor.summary: With a 5,000gp+ guildhouse, attracts 2d6 1st level elven purveyors in 1d4 weeks; extra passive investments; can run a syndicate (half-value hideout).

bao_purveyor.name: Specialty Merchandiser
bao_purveyor.summary: Gains a third specialty merchandise with all the same benefits.

bao_purveyor.name: Reputational Investment
bao_purveyor.summary: In his guildhouse market, raises specialty sale prices by the return rate of a related business worth enough for the market class (e.g. Class II 25,000gp).

bao_ranger.name: Animal Reflexes
bao_ranger.summary: +1 to initiative and +1 to avoid surprise (+2 in wilderness with Attunement to Nature).

bao_ranger.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_ranger.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack table).

bao_ranger.name: Mobile Warfare
bao_ranger.summary: +1 AC in medium or lighter armor with 7 stone or less encumbrance; stacks with Swashbuckling in light armor at 5 stone or less.

bao_ranger.name: Natural Stealth
bao_ranger.summary: Opponents take -2 to surprise rolls when he approaches from out of sight or lies in wait in cover or darkness.

bao_ranger.name: Precise Shooting
bao_ranger.summary: Missile attacks on unengaged foes past cover or engaged allies without penalty; -4 vs engaged targets. One rank of Precise Shooting.

bao_ranger.name: Regrouping
bao_ranger.summary: Party (up to a company) can scatter to his last rendezvous point when evading; successful groups return without encounters or getting lost.

bao_ranger.name: Sylvan Ranging
bao_ranger.summary: Speed x1 in forest/forested hills, x2/3 in forested mountains/swamp; shares with 1 creature per level; ranger units count as cavalry for recon there.

bao_ranger.name: Tracking
bao_ranger.summary: Searches for tracks for 1 turn on an 11+ Tracking throw, then follows at half speed. One rank of Tracking proficiency.

bao_ranger.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_ranger.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_ranger.name: Connection to Nature
bao_ranger.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_ranger.name: Elf Tongues
bao_ranger.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_ranger.name: Waylaying
bao_ranger.summary: Up to one ally per level lying in wait with him in sight or earshot gains his Natural Stealth benefit.

bao_ranger.name: Experience and Hardiness
bao_ranger.summary: Hirelings on a wilderness adventure he leads get +1 morale (stacks with CHA and proficiencies).

bao_ranger.name: Fastness
bao_ranger.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st level elven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay normal rates.

bao_ranger.name: Cunning and Flexible Reconnaissance
bao_ranger.summary: Commanding scouts/screen or the army: enemy armies count one row closer on recon results (or one column better); enemies treat his army as one worse.

bao_spellsinger.name: Arcane Spellsinging
bao_spellsinger.summary: Casts arcane spells with spell points (1/2/3/5/7/10 SP for spell levels 1-6); repertoire = listed + INT bonus; SP recover with 8 hours rest once per day.

bao_spellsinger.name: Ambient Magic Tapping
bao_spellsinger.summary: Can draw on places of power to fuel spells without spending SP; while sensing power, auto-identifies and ranks places of power.

bao_spellsinger.name: Extemporaneous Spells
bao_spellsinger.summary: Can improvise new spells on the fly from chords of power she knows; highly risky (see Elven Spellsinging chapter).

bao_spellsinger.name: Elven Glamour
bao_spellsinger.summary: +1 to reaction rolls to impress/intimidate; a total of 12+ leaves subjects bewitched while in your presence. Not vs. elven glamour. Like Mystic Aura.

bao_spellsinger.name: Locus of Will
bao_spellsinger.summary: +2 bonus to all saving throws (already included in the saving throw table).

bao_spellsinger.name: Memory Palace
bao_spellsinger.summary: Stores repertoire in a memory palace instead of a spellbook; no daily study; adding a spell takes 1 week with a written formula or a teacher.

bao_spellsinger.name: Performance
bao_spellsinger.summary: Could earn 10gp/month performing; identifies famous performers, works, and songs on 11+. One rank of Performance proficiency.

bao_spellsinger.name: Sensing Power
bao_spellsinger.summary: After 1 round of concentration, detects casters within 45' and their relative power and magic used in 24 hrs; 1 round/level, once per turn.

bao_spellsinger.name: Shaded Magic
bao_spellsinger.summary: Lacks formulaic protection against black magic; learning and singing the wrong songs can endanger her soul (see Elven Spellsinging chapter).

bao_spellsinger.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_spellsinger.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_spellsinger.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_spellsinger.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_spellsinger.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_spellsinger.summary: Can learn/cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells, craft constructs, create crossbreeds; if chaotic, create necromantic servants and become undead.

bao_spellsword.name: Arcane Magic
bao_spellsword.summary: Casts arcane spells per the Spellsword Spell Progression; repertoire = spells listed + INT bonus; can cast spells while wearing armor.

bao_spellsword.name: Collegiate Wizardry
bao_spellsword.summary: Can belong to a wizard's guild; auto-identifies own tradition's symbols, signatures, and grimoires, others on 11+. One rank of Collegiate Wizardry.

bao_spellsword.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_spellsword.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_spellsword.name: Elf Tongues

bao_spellsword.name: Major Magical Research

bao_spellsword.name: Fastness

bao_spellsword.name: Supreme Magical Research
bao_spellsword.summary: Can learn/cast 7th-9th level ritual spells, craft constructs, create crossbreeds and necromantic servants. (Only beyond normal max level 10.)

bao_warrior.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_warrior.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack table).

bao_warrior.name: Manual of Arms
bao_warrior.summary: Identifies homeland's military standards, gear, and insignia (others on 11+); fights as a regular in formed and loose units. One rank of Manual of Arms.

bao_warrior.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_warrior.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_warrior.name: Connection to Nature
bao_warrior.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_warrior.name: Elf Tongues
bao_warrior.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_warrior.name: Battle Focus
bao_warrior.summary: Full-round action, once per day per level: +1 to attacks, proficiency throws, saves, and initiative for 1 turn or until felled.

bao_warrior.name: Heroic Presence
bao_warrior.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he hires get +1 morale when he personally leads them (stacks with CHA and proficiencies).

bao_warrior.name: Fastness
bao_warrior.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st level elven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay normal rates.

bao_warrior.name: Unconquerable Soul
bao_warrior.summary: +1 to all saves (in table); at 0 hp or less can fight on up to 4 rounds: -2/-5/-10 on Mortal Wounds for 1/2/3 rounds, dies after the 4th.

bao_wizard.name: Arcane Magic
bao_wizard.summary: Casts arcane spells per the Wizard Spell Progression; repertoire = spells listed + INT bonus.

bao_wizard.name: Collegiate Wizardry
bao_wizard.summary: Can belong to a wizard's guild; auto-identifies own tradition's symbols, signatures, and grimoires, others on 11+. One rank of Collegiate Wizardry.

bao_wizard.name: Tradition of Magic
bao_wizard.summary: Chooses a tradition (artifice, elementalism, ensorcellment; necromancy or transmogrification with Judge's OK) granting powers at 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Mechanisms of Magic
bao_wizard.summary: +1 magic research throws, +5% research rate; recognizes common magic items/components on 11+ (1 turn); extracts special components from constructs.

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Elemental Mastery
bao_wizard.summary: Chosen element's spells: +1 damage per die, -2 to saves; its elementals +1 hp/HD; elemental mage missiles; auto-identifies its places of power.

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Master of Enchantments & Illusions
bao_wizard.summary: Enchantment/illusion spells at +2 caster levels, -2 to targets' saves; +2 research throws, +10% rate (+3 levels/-3 saves with the proficiency).

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Secrets of the Dark Arts
bao_wizard.summary: Controls undead as a chaotic crusader of half level; -2 to saves vs his death spells; necromantic spells and research at +2 levels (+2 throw, +10% rate).

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Grotesque Arts of Transformation
bao_wizard.summary: Transmogrification spells at +2 caster levels, -2 to saves; crossbreed/transmog research at +2 levels, +2 throw, +10% rate (stacks with proficiency).

bao_wizard.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_wizard.summary: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness; Adventuring search/listen on 14+ (instead of 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if separately proficient.

bao_wizard.name: Connection to Nature
bao_wizard.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

bao_wizard.name: Elf Tongues
bao_wizard.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Mechanisms of War
bao_wizard.summary: Gains one rank of Siege Engineering proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 2 ranks).

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Elements of War
bao_wizard.summary: Gains one rank of Military Strategy proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Influence
bao_wizard.summary: Gains his choice of Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Seduction proficiency.

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Mortuary Science
bao_wizard.summary: Gains one rank of Healing proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Alchemy
bao_wizard.summary: Gains one rank of Alchemy proficiency (or another general proficiency if already at 3 ranks).

bao_wizard.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_wizard.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Art of Unmaking
bao_wizard.summary: Can cast dispel magic once per day.

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Spellward
bao_wizard.summary: Can cast spellward once per day.

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Figments of Imagination
bao_wizard.summary: Can cast chimerical figment once per day.

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Speak with Dead
bao_wizard.summary: Can cast speak with the dead once per day.

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Bestial Transformation
bao_wizard.summary: Can cast skinchange once per day.

bao_wizard.name: Personal Study
bao_wizard.summary: Gains one additional class proficiency from his class list.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Expanded Repertoire
bao_wizard.summary: +1 repertoire slot per castable spell level, which must hold blast or wall spells.

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Expanded Repertoire
bao_wizard.summary: +1 repertoire slot per castable spell level, which must hold elemental spells.

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Expanded Repertoire
bao_wizard.summary: +1 repertoire slot per castable spell level, which must hold enchantment or illusion spells.

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Expanded Repertoire
bao_wizard.summary: +1 repertoire slot per castable spell level, which must hold death or necromancy spells.

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Expanded Repertoire
bao_wizard.summary: +1 repertoire slot per castable spell level, which must hold transmogrification spells.

bao_wizard.name: Major Magical Research
bao_wizard.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_wizard.name: Sanctum
bao_wizard.summary: With a 15,000gp+ sanctum, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd level and 2d6 0th level apprentices within 1d3 months; they assist magic research for room and board.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Flawless Precision
bao_wizard.summary: Ordinary (non-experimental) magic research no longer fails automatically on natural 2-3; a natural 1 still fails.

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Elemental Exarchy
bao_wizard.summary: Elemental spells of any type are cast at +2 caster levels (+3 for the element of his Elementalism proficiency).

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Bewitching Aura
bao_wizard.summary: +1 to reaction rolls to impress/intimidate; total 12+ bewitches while in his presence. With Mystic Aura, bewitchment lasts one day instead.

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Lordship Over the Undead
bao_wizard.summary: Controlled undead stay controlled 1 day per level instead of 1 turn per level; a 'D' result controls them indefinitely.

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Hideous Servant
bao_wizard.summary: Gains a bonded servant like a shaman's totem animal, mixing two traits each from two animals with averaged base HD; no totem benefit.

bao_wizard.name: Supreme Magical Research
bao_wizard.summary: Can learn/cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells, craft constructs, create crossbreeds; if chaotic, create necromantic servants and become undead.

bao_wizard.name: Artifice: Marvelous Machines
bao_wizard.summary: Designs and builds constructs at half the usual material and research cost.

bao_wizard.name: Elementalism: Place of Power
bao_wizard.summary: Home/sanctum becomes a minor elemental place of power (9,000 sq ft), or rises one rank; inside it he is invulnerable to his element's damage type.

bao_wizard.name: Ensorcellment: Ensorcellment Unending
bao_wizard.summary: Perpetual enchantments/illusions count as half a spell toward his limit and persist after death while his memory lives (225+ years).

bao_wizard.name: Necromancy: Secrets of Life and Death
bao_wizard.summary: Performs necromancy at half the usual material and research cost.

bao_wizard.name: Transmogrification: Shape Flesh and Bone
bao_wizard.summary: Creates magical crossbreeds at half the usual material and research cost.

bao_antiquarian.name: Archeoturgy
bao_antiquarian.summary: Can use any elf-made (or elven-formula) activated/charged implement, ring, or misc. item without its command word; needs 4+ throw or it backfires.

bao_antiquarian.name: Collegiate Wizardry
bao_antiquarian.summary: May start in a museum or arcane order; auto-identifies own tradition's symbols, signatures, and grimoires, others on 11+. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_antiquarian.name: Deciphering
bao_antiquarian.summary: Deciphers ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages (not magic writing): 1 turn per page, 4+ on 1d20; a failed page can't be retried until next level.

bao_antiquarian.name: Exegesis
bao_antiquarian.summary: Reads treatises in 3 days and references them in 3 turns. An ancillary activity in a library adds its gp value to his XP when figuring level for Loremastery.

bao_antiquarian.name: Lockpicking
bao_antiquarian.summary: Picks locks with thieves' tools: hasty (1 round; nat 1-3 jams lock) or methodical (1 turn, +4; nat 1 jams). Throw 18+ at 1st, improving to 3+ at 11th.

bao_antiquarian.name: Loremastery
bao_antiquarian.summary: 18+ throw (-1 per level) to read occult runes, recall history, identify artifacts or monster parts. IDs magic items as 5th-lvl mage or +2 throw/+10% rate.

bao_antiquarian.name: Polyglottery
bao_antiquarian.summary: Gains three bonus languages, chosen now from tongues common in the starting region or later from languages met in play.

bao_antiquarian.name: Searching
bao_antiquarian.summary: Finds traps, secret doors, hidden items within 5': hasty (1 round) or methodical (1 turn, +4); can hastily search while exploring. 16+ at 1st, 1+ at 11th.

bao_antiquarian.name: Trapbreaking
bao_antiquarian.summary: Disarms traps with thieves' tools: hasty (1 round; nat 1-3 triggers it) or methodical (1 turn, +4; nat 1 triggers). Throw 18+ at 1st, improving to 3+ at 11th.

bao_antiquarian.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_antiquarian.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_antiquarian.name: Connection to Nature
bao_antiquarian.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_antiquarian.name: Elf Tongues
bao_antiquarian.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_antiquarian.name: Arcane Magic
bao_antiquarian.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Antiquarian Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 5th-level spells at 11th); can cast in medium or lighter armor.

bao_antiquarian.name: Mechanisms of Magic
bao_antiquarian.summary: +1 magic research throws and +5% research rate; IDs common magic items/special components in 1 turn on 11+; can harvest components from constructs.

bao_antiquarian.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_antiquarian.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_antiquarian.name: Museum
bao_antiquarian.summary: With a 15,000gp+ museum, gains 1d6 1st-3rd level apprentice antiquarians and 2d6 0th-level apprentices as research assistants; a menagerie draws monsters.

bao_antiquarian.name: Cataloguing
bao_antiquarian.summary: Base cost of identified magic items kept in his museum is added to its library's gp value for magic research by him, his assistants, and permitted casters.

bao_antiquarian.name: Major Magical Research
bao_antiquarian.summary: If he can reach 12th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_duskveil.name: Deadly Grace
bao_duskveil.summary: +1 AC in medium or lighter armor with 7 st or less encumbrance; stacks with Swashbuckling if in light armor carrying 5 st or less.

bao_duskveil.name: Performance
bao_duskveil.summary: Trained dancer (could earn 10gp/month); identifies renowned performers, famous works, and unusual songs on 11+. Equals 1 rank of Performance.

bao_duskveil.name: Provoke the Passions
bao_duskveil.summary: Full round, stationary: a creature within 30' that sees/hears her saves vs Spells or is provoked 1d4 rds +1/level, shifting reaction (hostile to enraged, etc.).

bao_duskveil.name: Protective Ward
bao_duskveil.summary: Designates a willing creature in sight as ward: +1 AC and Blast saves (stacks with her Defend). Ends if she ends initiative 5'+ away, falls, or picks another.

bao_duskveil.name: Whirling Veils
bao_duskveil.summary: In revealing armor: +1 AC or use CHA bonus in place of DEX for AC; both if STR, DEX, CON, CHA all 11+. Stacks with Deadly Grace and Swashbuckling.

bao_duskveil.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_duskveil.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_duskveil.name: Connection to Nature
bao_duskveil.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_duskveil.name: Elf Tongues
bao_duskveil.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_duskveil.name: Arcane Magic
bao_duskveil.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Duskveil Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 5th-level spells at 11th); can cast in medium or lighter armor.

bao_duskveil.name: Flourish and Flow
bao_duskveil.summary: With a cloak and a bladed weapon, counts as having a shield when Defending herself or ward; magic cloak raises ward's AC bonus vs thrown weapons to +4.

bao_duskveil.name: Covering Withdrawal
bao_duskveil.summary: A ward who starts initiative adjacent to her may withdraw or retreat from melee without declaring it first, as if he had Skirmishing.

bao_duskveil.name: Defensive Veil
bao_duskveil.summary: After damage is rolled, may cut damage to her ward by up to half (rounded up) by taking twice the amount deflected herself.

bao_duskveil.name: Deadly Desire
bao_duskveil.summary: Targets of Provoke the Passions take -2 on the save; on a failure she may shift their reaction one extra step in either direction.

bao_duskveil.name: Death Healing
bao_duskveil.summary: When she fells a sentient creature in melee, may expend a spell slot to heal 1d6 per slot level (max victim's starting hp); may still cleave afterward.

bao_duskveil.name: Battle Hardened
bao_duskveil.summary: Rolls twice on the Mortal Wounds table and picks the result; subtracts her class level from days of bed rest needed to recover.

bao_duskveil.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_duskveil.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_duskveil.name: Arcane Shielding
bao_duskveil.summary: When she or her ward is hit by B/P/S damage, may expend a spell slot before damage to reduce it 1d6 per slot level; 0 damage means no other hit effects.

bao_duskveil.name: Vigilant Ward
bao_duskveil.summary: If stationary, she can use her movement action instead of her combat action to Defend her ward.

bao_duskveil.name: Seraglio
bao_duskveil.summary: With a 15,000gp+ seraglio (former wards may fund half), attracts 1d2x10 1st-level duskveils and 1d6x30 elven women trainees; trainees turn over yearly.

bao_duskveil.name: Major Magical Research
bao_duskveil.summary: If she can reach 12th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_dweomerbow.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack throw table).

bao_dweomerbow.name: Long-Range Volleying
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Treats medium range as short and long range as medium for attack penalties; still can't snipe beyond short range without Sniping. Equals the proficiency.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Manual of Arms
bao_dweomerbow.summary: IDs military gear, standards, and ranks of his homeland; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed/loose units. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Mobile Warfare
bao_dweomerbow.summary: +1 AC when wearing medium or lighter armor and carrying 7 stones or less encumbrance.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Precise Shooting
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Missile attacks on unengaged foes take no penalty past cover or engaged allies; can shoot engaged foes at -4. Equals 1 rank of Precise Shooting.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Predictive Positioning
bao_dweomerbow.summary: +1 AC vs missile attacks and +1 Blast saves; rises to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 13th. (Save bonus already in table.)

bao_dweomerbow.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Connection to Nature
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_dweomerbow.name: Elf Tongues
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Arcane Magic
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Dweomerbow Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 5th-level spells at 11th); can cast while armored.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Charged Shot
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Full-round stationary shot: choose arcane, cold, electric, fire, or sonic damage, and may spend a spell slot for +1d6 per slot level. Miss loses ammo and slot.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Impact of Impetus
bao_dweomerbow.summary: On a charged shot, spend a slot for impetus: on a hit, target makes size-adjusted Paralysis save or is forced back damage + 1d6' per slot level.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Redirection by Ricochet
bao_dweomerbow.summary: On a charged shot, spend a slot to ricochet off objects (AC 0) up to slot level times, tracing sight from the projectile to hit flanks or around corners.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Rain of Arrows
bao_dweomerbow.summary: On a charged shot, spend a slot to gain extra attacks equal to slot level, each at a separate target; each extra attack uses up one of his cleaves.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Loosing of Lightning
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Ignores the cleave limit of composite and long bows, cleaving up to once per level (also raising Rain of Arrows extra attacks).

bao_dweomerbow.name: Fastness
bao_dweomerbow.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level elven mercenaries, who must be paid normal mercenary rates.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Projection of Power
bao_dweomerbow.summary: Charged shots can use no ammunition, gaining +1 initiative; must deal arcane, cold, electric, fire, or sonic damage rather than weapon damage.

bao_dweomerbow.name: Major Magical Research
bao_dweomerbow.summary: If he can reach 12th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Artisanship
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Grandmaster (4 ranks) of one art/craft: IDs masterworks on 2+, builds 80gp/month, supervises up to 14 helpers; +4 breakthrough on related experiments.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Dweomercraft
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Creates magic items (not potions/scrolls) using repertoire spells or formulas; research rate 5gp/day and throw 16+ at 1st, improving by level. Needs a workshop.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Repertoire of Effects
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Keeps an arcane or divine (chosen at 1st) repertoire per the Repertoire Progression table +INT bonus; cannot cast these spells, only enchant them into items.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Simple Sorcery
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Performs minor cantrips (calm animals, clean odors, warm rooms) taking 1 turn each; can imbue them into items as 1/5th-level spells.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Spiritual Investment
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Pays special component costs with own divine power per day (1gp at 1st, 205gp at 13th); +10 per point from a fastness's sacred tree with the arborist's OK.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Utilization of Items
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Can use any magic item usable by casters of his repertoire type (arcane or divine) or matching his weapon/armor proficiencies; command words still needed.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Connection to Nature
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_dweomerwright.name: Elf Tongues
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Feanor Did Nothing Wrong Rule
bao_dweomerwright.summary: If his most powerful crafted permanent item is stolen, may become an elven warrior of equal level (Kin-Slaying/Goblin-Slaying/Berserkergang); can't be raised.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Advanced Studies
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Gains one bonus proficiency of his choice: Arcane Dabbling, Expanded Repertoire, Experimentation, Loremastery, Magical Engineering, or Sensing Power.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Repertoire Research
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Can research existing or new spells of levels he can learn and add them to his repertoire with a week of practice; still cannot cast them.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Flawless Precision
bao_dweomerwright.summary: On ordinary (non-experimental) magic research, unmodified rolls of 2-3 are no longer automatic failures; a natural 1 still fails.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Atelier
bao_dweomerwright.summary: With a 15,000gp+ atelier, gains 1d6 1st-3rd level apprentice dweomerwrights and 2d6 0th-level apprentices as crafting assistants; a menagerie draws monsters.

bao_dweomerwright.name: Ritual Dweomercraft
bao_dweomerwright.summary: Learns ritual spells as an 11th-level caster of his type and can imbue them into items (e.g. wand or ring), though he cannot perform rituals directly.

bao_envoy.name: Ambassador's Insight
bao_envoy.summary: Knows the true reaction result of sapient creatures even if concealed, unless their CHA >= his INT; immune to their Mystic Aura and Treachery surprise.

bao_envoy.name: Deciphering
bao_envoy.summary: Deciphers contracts, treaties, ciphers, maps, and dead languages (not magic): 1 turn per page, 4+ on 1d20; failed page can't be retried until next level.

bao_envoy.name: Diplomacy
bao_envoy.summary: +1 to reaction rolls when parlaying with intelligent creatures. Equals Diplomacy proficiency.

bao_envoy.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_envoy.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack throw table).

bao_envoy.name: Judicial Dueling
bao_envoy.summary: +1 to attack throws and +1 AC when in single combat (one foe, no allies engaging the same target), formal duel or not.

bao_envoy.name: Legal Expertise
bao_envoy.summary: 11+ throw to identify laws, customs, and codes, judge legal implications, jurisdiction, and precedent. Equals 1 rank of Profession (lawyer).

bao_envoy.name: Listening
bao_envoy.summary: Judge secretly rolls Listening (10+ at 1st, improving 1/level to -1+ at 11th) to hear noises in earshot; 1 round, once per turn if party is moving.

bao_envoy.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_envoy.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_envoy.name: Connection to Nature
bao_envoy.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_envoy.name: Elf Tongues
bao_envoy.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_envoy.name: Arcane Magic
bao_envoy.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Envoy Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 5th-level spells at 11th); can cast in light or very light armor.

bao_envoy.name: Ambassador's Inference
bao_envoy.summary: After 1 turn of talk, secret Listening throw (+INT, minus target's reaction mods) reveals if a creature is forthright; bad fail misleads. Can spy via Listening.

bao_envoy.name: Binding Compact
bao_envoy.summary: Seals a magical pact between two willing parties (1/month, max half level active); breakers are cursed with -2 to saves and reaction rolls.

bao_envoy.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_envoy.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_envoy.name: Embassy
bao_envoy.summary: With a 5,000gp+ embassy, attracts 2d6 1st-level envoys (one a spy); runs it as a hideout for carousing, slander, smuggling, soliciting, and spying hijinks.

bao_envoy.name: Seal of Accord
bao_envoy.summary: In 1 turn, makes a small object a token of an active compact; it glows gold or crimson to discern magic, and keeps the compact alive after his death.

bao_envoy.name: Ambassador's Intelligence
bao_envoy.summary: +4 to saves vs enchantments; counts as INT 18 (or 19 with +4 modifier if already 18) for Ambassador's Insight and Inference.

bao_envoy.name: Major Magical Research
bao_envoy.summary: If he can reach 12th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_healer.name: Divine Magic
bao_healer.summary: Casts divine spells from the Elven Healer Repertoire list per the Healer Spell Progression (one 1st-level spell at 1st, up to 6th-level spells at 11th).

bao_healer.name: Healing
bao_healer.summary: Tends 6 patients (+1d3 hp/day rest); diagnoses illness/poison on 3+; on 14+ can nonmagically cure disease, poison, or serious injury. Equals 3 ranks of Healing.

bao_healer.name: Laying on Hands
bao_healer.summary: Once per day by touch: heal 2 hp per level, give +half level (round up) to a Mortal Wounds throw, or cure paralysis. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_healer.name: Mastery of Salving and Saving
bao_healer.summary: Healing spells act as if 2 levels higher; +2 throw and +10% rate researching healing magic; touch healing spells reach 15'. Not for reversed spells.

bao_healer.name: Rebuke Undead
bao_healer.summary: Rebukes undead per the Healer Rebuking table (skeletons 10+ at 1st, auto-destroy at 6th); 2d6 HD affected flee for 1 turn. Lawful also rebuke demons.

bao_healer.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_healer.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_healer.name: Connection to Nature
bao_healer.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_healer.name: Elf Tongues
bao_healer.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_healer.name: Code of Behavior
bao_healer.summary: Demara's strictures: white robes and shawl in public, 1-hr dusk prayers, weekly night flame, hunting weapons only, chaste until 7th, no divine harm to elves.

bao_healer.name: Radiant Garland
bao_healer.summary: Hair shines like daylight to 30', torchlight to 60', dim to 90'; +1 to all saves while visible. Can be veiled with headwear at start of initiative.

bao_healer.name: Spiritual Rejuvenation
bao_healer.summary: Enervated patients under his Healing care get +1 to Death saves; after three successes in a row, they reroll max hp with full HD, keeping a higher result.

bao_healer.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_healer.summary: Can scribe magical scrolls and brew potions.

bao_healer.name: Inspire Hope
bao_healer.summary: 1 round of oration gives allies within 30' temporary hp by max hp (1d2 to 6d10+) for 1 turn; 1/day, +1 use per level after 7th. +1 temp hp if Garland unveiled.

bao_healer.name: Peaceful Aura
bao_healer.summary: With Radiant Garland unveiled, +1 to reaction rolls; a total of 12+ grants sanctuary vs those creatures (Spells save to attack him) until he acts hostile.

bao_healer.name: Fate of the Soul
bao_healer.summary: After 1 turn studying a corpse, learns the result restore life and limb would have; prediction holds if acted on before the next sunrise or sunset.

bao_healer.name: Major Magical Research
bao_healer.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_healer.name: Hospital
bao_healer.summary: With a 15,000gp+ hospital (former patients may fund half), attracts 1d2x10 1st-level healers and 1d6x30 aspirants; aspirants turn over yearly.

bao_healer.name: Supreme Magical Research
bao_healer.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual divine spells and craft magical constructs; if chaotic, can create necromantic servants and become undead.

bao_healer.name: Amelioration of Suffering
bao_healer.summary: 1/month, 1 turn of prayer removes one side effect of tampering with mortality or cost of conception; recipient gets a Lawful quest. Once per lifetime each.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Crossbreeding
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Blends progenitors (HD up to his level) into crossbreeds at 2,000gp/HD plus ability costs; rate 5gp/day and throw 16+ at 1st, improving by level. Needs a lab.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Crossbreed Bonding
bao_lifeshaper.summary: +1 to reaction rolls with crossbreeds he made and +1 to their loyalty as henchmen; may keep one extra henchman if one is his crossbreed.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Measure of the Specimen
bao_lifeshaper.summary: 1 hour ancillary activity and crossbreeding throw reveals a creature's attribute scores, which can be kept in crossbreeds; enables crossgrafting.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Healing and Husbandry
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Gains one rank of his choice of Animal Husbandry or Healing proficiency.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Laying on Hands
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Once per day by touch: heal 2 hp per level, give +half level (round up) to a Mortal Wounds throw, or cure paralysis. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Personal Crossbreed
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Starts with a bonded 1 HD crossbreed follower (loyalty/morale +4); each level can upgrade or remake it with HD up to his level, -7,000gp cost, auto-success.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Urgent Care
bao_lifeshaper.summary: +1 bonus to surprise rolls and initiative rolls.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Connection to Nature
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_lifeshaper.name: Elf Tongues
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Cure Disease
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Can cure disease (as the spell) once per 8 hours; each use takes 1 turn.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Vivarium
bao_lifeshaper.summary: With a 15,000gp+ vivarium, gains 1d6 1st-3rd level apprentice lifeshapers and 2d6 0th-level apprentices as crossbreeding assistants; a menagerie draws monsters.

bao_lifeshaper.name: Mass Crossbreeding
bao_lifeshaper.summary: Runs any number of identical crossbreeding projects at once, paying research cost once and material cost per creature; one throw for the batch.

bao_oakheart.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_oakheart.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack throw table).

bao_oakheart.name: Manual of Arms
bao_oakheart.summary: IDs military gear, standards, and ranks of his homeland; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed/loose units. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_oakheart.name: Robust Strength
bao_oakheart.summary: 1/day, full round: for 1 turn gains +2 melee attacks, +1 damage die (extraordinary), hurls boulders 1200' for 3d6, +8 Dungeonbashing, 2x carry, counts as huge.

bao_oakheart.name: Unyielding
bao_oakheart.summary: +2 to saves vs being grabbed, knocked down, restrained, wrestled, or forcibly moved; may use CON bonus in place of DEX bonus to AC.

bao_oakheart.name: Plant-Like
bao_oakheart.summary: Immune to humanoid-only effects, hit by plant-only ones; no food if working in sunlight; can't become undead or use max-level rituals; -1/level on Tampering.

bao_oakheart.name: Lignification of the Flesh
bao_oakheart.summary: Drawback: suffers a random tree-like affliction (1d10 table) at 1st level and again at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, and possibly 13th.

bao_oakheart.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_oakheart.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_oakheart.name: Connection to Nature
bao_oakheart.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_oakheart.name: Elf Tongues
bao_oakheart.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_oakheart.name: Bark Skin
bao_oakheart.summary: Permanent +1 bonus to AC that stacks with all other AC bonuses.

bao_oakheart.name: Buttress of the Elves
bao_oakheart.summary: Elven henchmen and mercenaries he leads get +1 morale while he is present, stacking with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

bao_oakheart.name: Life-Giving Sap
bao_oakheart.summary: Dripping his sap on his own or an adjacent creature's wounds for 1 turn heals 1d6+1; unlimited uses, but each needs an extra pint of water within 1 hour.

bao_oakheart.name: Bark Skin II
bao_oakheart.summary: Another permanent +1 AC (total +2), but base speed drops to 90'.

bao_oakheart.name: Tannic Tissue
bao_oakheart.summary: Resists mundane poison and necrotic damage; immune to natural disease and swarm damage; biters save vs Poison or are queasy 1d4 rounds.

bao_oakheart.name: Fastness
bao_oakheart.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level elven mercenaries, who must be paid normal mercenary rates.

bao_oakheart.name: Bark Skin III
bao_oakheart.summary: Another permanent +1 AC (total +3), but base speed drops to 60'.

bao_oakheart.name: Call of the Forest
bao_oakheart.summary: Choose: stop gaining XP, or take a final lignification and advance to 14th (1M more XP) to become a treeherder (HD 14, AC 10, 2 smashes 4d6).

bao_skyknight.name: Champion of the Banner
bao_skyknight.summary: +1 to attack throws vs leaders, standard bearers, or solitary monsters with HD/level above his own; rises to +2 at 7th and +3 at 13th.

bao_skyknight.name: Manual of Arms
bao_skyknight.summary: IDs military gear, standards, and ranks of his homeland; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed/loose units. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_skyknight.name: Right Stuff
bao_skyknight.summary: When reduced to half max hp or less in an encounter, gains +1 to AC, attacks, proficiency throws, saves, and initiative for 1 turn or until healed.

bao_skyknight.name: Saddleborn
bao_skyknight.summary: Rides a saddled mount in combat without penalty and gets +1 to attacks while mounted; with Riding, needs no saddle or bridle. Equals Mounted Combat.

bao_skyknight.name: Tight Grip
bao_skyknight.summary: When knocked off his mount, makes a Paralysis save at +2; success means he catches hold instead of falling (still needs a move action to remount).

bao_skyknight.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_skyknight.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_skyknight.name: Connection to Nature
bao_skyknight.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_skyknight.name: Elf Tongues
bao_skyknight.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_skyknight.name: Arcane Magic
bao_skyknight.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Skyknight Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 4th-level spells at 11th); can cast while armored.

bao_skyknight.name: Strength of Spirit
bao_skyknight.summary: Immune to all natural and magical fear effects.

bao_skyknight.name: Binding of the Winged Steed
bao_skyknight.summary: After 1 turn of prayer at an aerie, a pegasus arrives in ~1d10 hours as a follower (loyalty/morale +4). Hippogriff at 6th+, griffon at 9th+ for replacements.

bao_skyknight.name: Battlespace Awareness
bao_skyknight.summary: Never counts as flanked, subjacent, or vulnerable to rear attacks (still vulnerable when prone, helpless, surprised, grabbed, etc.).

bao_skyknight.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_skyknight.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_skyknight.name: Spell Strafing
bao_skyknight.summary: When charging on his winged steed's flight, can hastily cast a spell instead of attacking; needs an attack throw vs AC 1 per 60' moved or the spell is lost.

bao_skyknight.name: Fastness
bao_skyknight.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level elven mercenaries, who must be paid normal mercenary rates.

bao_skyknight.name: Winnowing of the Weak
bao_skyknight.summary: While on his winged steed, cleaves as if twice his class level and deals an extra damage die on an unmodified 20.

bao_skyknight.name: Sky-Streaming Banner
bao_skyknight.summary: Flying on his pegasus over an army with its banner, the army auto-stands firm on its first morale roll (or rallies). Lost if he routs or loses the banner.

bao_skyknight.name: Major Magical Research
bao_skyknight.summary: If he can reach 14th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_spelljack.name: Arcane Magic
bao_spelljack.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Spelljack Spell Progression (one 1st-level spell at 1st, up to 5th-level spells at 9th) plus INT bonus.

bao_spelljack.name: Climbing
bao_spelljack.summary: Climbs sheer surfaces with a throw per 100' (6+ at 1st, improving 1/level to -3+ at 10th); failure means a fall. -5/-10 for faster movement.

bao_spelljack.name: Collegiate Wizardry
bao_spelljack.summary: May start in a wizard's guild; auto-identifies own tradition's symbols, signatures, and grimoires, others on 11+. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_spelljack.name: Hiding
bao_spelljack.summary: Hides as a combat action in cover or dim light (19+ at 1st, 6+ at 10th); hidden means no line of sight on him. Foes get -2 surprise while he's stationary.

bao_spelljack.name: Listening
bao_spelljack.summary: Judge secretly rolls Listening (10+ at 1st, improving 1/level to 1+ at 10th) to hear noises in earshot; 1 round, once per turn if party is moving.

bao_spelljack.name: Lockpicking
bao_spelljack.summary: Picks locks with thieves' tools: hasty (1 round; nat 1-3 jams lock) or methodical (1 turn, +4; nat 1 jams). Throw 18+ at 1st, improving to 5+ at 10th.

bao_spelljack.name: Magical Tradition
bao_spelljack.summary: Starts with one of Black Lore of Zahar, Elementalism, Magical Engineering, Mastery of Enchantments & Illusions, or Transmogrification, to pass as a wizard.

bao_spelljack.name: Quiet Magic
bao_spelljack.summary: Casts with minimal words and gestures; hearing him cast needs a successful hear-noise throw, and only full binding and gagging stops his magic.

bao_spelljack.name: Pickpocketing
bao_spelljack.summary: Within 5', steals one pocket's contents or unheld item (17+ at 1st, 4+ at 10th; +4 if target unaware). Nat 1 or under half target: noticed.

bao_spelljack.name: Searching
bao_spelljack.summary: Finds traps, secret doors, hidden items within 5': hasty (1 round) or methodical (1 turn, +4); can hastily search while exploring. 16+ at 1st, 3+ at 10th.

bao_spelljack.name: Shadowy Senses
bao_spelljack.summary: At combat or exploration speed, perceives as if with a dim 30' light; can fight and find traps but not read or see colors. Fails in bright light or silence.

bao_spelljack.name: Sneaking
bao_spelljack.summary: Sneaks silently as a movement action (17+ at 1st, 4+ at 10th; -5/-10 if faster); foes outside his sight get -2 to surprise rolls.

bao_spelljack.name: Streetwise
bao_spelljack.summary: May join a thieves' guild and perform hijinks; IDs criminal signs and slang at home, 11+ in other cities. Equals 1 rank of Streetwise.

bao_spelljack.name: Trapbreaking
bao_spelljack.summary: Disarms traps with thieves' tools: hasty (1 round; nat 1-3 triggers it) or methodical (1 turn, +4; nat 1 triggers). Throw 18+ at 1st, improving to 5+ at 10th.

bao_spelljack.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_spelljack.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_spelljack.name: Connection to Nature
bao_spelljack.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_spelljack.name: Elf Tongues
bao_spelljack.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_spelljack.name: Deciphering
bao_spelljack.summary: Deciphers ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages (not magic writing): 1 turn per page, 4+ on 1d20; a failed page can't be retried until next level.

bao_spelljack.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_spelljack.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

bao_spelljack.name: Major Magical Research
bao_spelljack.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_spelljack.name: Sanctum
bao_spelljack.summary: With a 15,000gp+ sanctum, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd and 2d6 0th-level apprentices (each a spelljack if 1d20+8 <= DEX, else a wizard); a dungeon draws monsters.

bao_spelljack.name: Spelljacking
bao_spelljack.summary: Combat action: Pickpocketing throw at -2 per spell level steals a casting from a caster within 5'; he can use it for his own spells until he rests.

bao_spelljack.name: Supreme Magical Research
bao_spelljack.summary: If he can reach 11th level, can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells and craft constructs, crossbreeds, and necromantic servants.

bao_swordseer.name: Ancient Memories
bao_swordseer.summary: 1 turn of focus grants +1 rank in any general proficiency for 6 turns (1 hour of focus: 8 hours); one memory at a time. Blocks Battle Foresight while active.

bao_swordseer.name: Battle Foresight
bao_swordseer.summary: Each round before initiative, choose +1 initiative, +1 attack, +1 AC, or +2 saves until next round (defaults to +1 AC). Not usable with Ancient Memories.

bao_swordseer.name: Elven Weapon Training
bao_swordseer.summary: +1 to attack throws with weapons of elven make (not included in the attack throw table).

bao_swordseer.name: Loremastery
bao_swordseer.summary: 18+ throw (-1 per level) to read occult runes, recall history, identify artifacts or monster parts. IDs magic items as 5th-lvl mage or +2 throw/+10% rate.

bao_swordseer.name: Manual of Arms
bao_swordseer.summary: IDs military gear, standards, and ranks of his homeland; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed/loose units. Equals 1 rank of the proficiency.

bao_swordseer.name: Attunement to Nature
bao_swordseer.summary: Racial: +1 to surprise rolls in wilderness. Adventuring search/listen succeeds on 14+; if proficient, +2 to Searching or +4 to Listening throws instead.

bao_swordseer.name: Connection to Nature
bao_swordseer.summary: Racial: immune to diseases caused by undead; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already included in tables).

bao_swordseer.name: Elf Tongues
bao_swordseer.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

bao_swordseer.name: Arcane Magic
bao_swordseer.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire per the Swordseer Spell Progression (CL 1 at 2nd, up to 5th-level spells at 11th); can cast in medium or lighter armor.

bao_swordseer.name: Moment of Reckoning
bao_swordseer.summary: On an unmodified 6 for initiative, acting at once makes him momentous: +1 attack/round and +1d6 arcane damage per hit; heroic success extends it (max 10 rds).

bao_swordseer.name: Noetic Senses
bao_swordseer.summary: Automatically tries to disbelieve any illusion met; +4 when deliberately disbelieving. With Illusion Resistance, rerolls first failed disbelief save each day.

bao_swordseer.name: Prophetic Dreaming
bao_swordseer.summary: Receives one prophetic dream per month from the Judge (two if he also has Prophecy). Equals Prophecy proficiency.

bao_swordseer.name: Minor Magical Research
bao_swordseer.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as if a 5th level mage.

bao_swordseer.name: Battlefield Awareness
bao_swordseer.summary: Never counts as flanked, subjacent, or vulnerable to rear attacks (still vulnerable when prone, helpless, surprised, grabbed, etc.).

bao_swordseer.name: Fastness
bao_swordseer.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level elven mercenaries, who must be paid normal mercenary rates.

bao_swordseer.name: Choice of Destiny
bao_swordseer.summary: Once per day, rerolls or forces a reroll of an attack, save, or any random roll within 60', automatically taking the better result for him.

bao_swordseer.name: Portents of War
bao_swordseer.summary: Spending an ancillary activity on omens at the start of the day grants +1 to strategic initiative and reconnaissance rolls that day.

bao_swordseer.name: Major Magical Research
bao_swordseer.summary: If he can reach 12th level, can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

bao_mountebank.name: Alchemical Interest
bao_mountebank.summary: IDs alchemicals on 1+, special components on 5+; extracts toxins on 6+ fresh/10+ dried; brews potions as a 5th-lvl mage at 50gp/day. Equals 3 ranks Alchemy.

bao_mountebank.name: Arcane Dabbling
bao_mountebank.summary: Can try to use wands, staffs, and other arcane-only magic items without knowing command words; needs 4+ on 1d20 or it backfires.

bao_mountebank.name: Brewing Quacksalves
bao_mountebank.summary: Brews cheap fake potions (50gp/spell level) from a real formula/sample; secret throw 10+ (+2/level) or it fails, deludes, or reverses. Max level: half his.

bao_mountebank.name: Disguising Elixir
bao_mountebank.summary: Brews in 1 turn (needs 800gp+ equipment) a self-only elixir to take any humanoid shape for 6 turns +1 turn per level; with Disguise can mimic a person.

bao_mountebank.name: Deceptive Cantrip
bao_mountebank.summary: 1/day by touch, for 24 hours: mask a carried magic item from detection, or make a mundane item seem magical with a harmless trait.

bao_mountebank.name: Listening
bao_mountebank.summary: Judge secretly rolls Listening to hear noises in earshot; must be quiet and closest to the sound; 1 round, once per turn if the party is moving.

bao_mountebank.name: Lying
bao_mountebank.summary: +1 to all reaction rolls when parlaying with intelligent creatures. Equals Diplomacy proficiency.

bao_mountebank.name: Poisoning
bao_mountebank.summary: Identifies poisons and venomous creatures, extracts venoms and plant toxins, and never botches extracting or using poison. Equals Poisoning proficiency.

bao_mountebank.name: Streetwise
bao_mountebank.summary: May join a thieves' guild and perform hijinks; IDs criminal signs and slang at home, 11+ in other cities. Equals 1 rank of Streetwise.

bao_mountebank.name: Swindling
bao_mountebank.summary: Buys at 10% less and sells at 10% more than list price; vs another bargainer, higher reaction roll wins. Equals 1 rank of Bargaining.

bao_mountebank.name: Treachery
bao_mountebank.summary: After Lying (or Bribery) earns a Friendly reaction, a treacherous attack forces all within 30' to roll surprise at -3; his party is exempt if signaled.

bao_mountebank.name: Gnome Tongues
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: speaks Common, Dwarven, Elven, Goblin, and Gnomish.

bao_mountebank.name: Heartier Constitution
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: +3 bonus on all saving throws (already included in the saving throw table).

bao_mountebank.name: Nose for Potions
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: 11+ throw to identify a potion or oil's properties by taste. From 5th level, brews potions as a mage of his class level.

bao_mountebank.name: Obsessive Interest
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: one bonus proficiency and +2 to throws for an obsession; for mountebanks this is Alchemical Interest (bonus already in target values).

bao_mountebank.name: Resistance to Illusions
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: automatically attempts to disbelieve any illusion encountered; +4 to the throw when deliberately disbelieving.

bao_mountebank.name: Short-Statured
bao_mountebank.summary: Racial: speed 90' unencumbered; cannot wield large melee weapons or long bows; must use two hands for medium weapons. Can use arbalests.

bao_mountebank.name: Deciphering
bao_mountebank.summary: Deciphers ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages (not magic writing): 1 turn per page, 4+ on 1d20; a failed page can't be retried until next level.

bao_mountebank.name: Alchemical Mastery
bao_mountebank.summary: Brews potions as a mage of his class level; Alchemical Interest now gives +3 to alchemy research throws and +15% alchemy research rate.

bao_mountebank.name: Dispensary
bao_mountebank.summary: With a 5,000gp+ dispensary, attracts 2d6 1st-level mountebanks (one a spy); can run it as a hideout at half value and make extra alchemy-related investments.

bao_mountebank.name: Scrollreading
bao_mountebank.summary: Can cast from arcane and divine scrolls in 1 round with a 4+ throw on 1d20; failure may cause a horrible effect.

bta_delver.name: Attention to Detail
bta_delver.summary: +2 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_delver.name: Backstabbing
bta_delver.summary: +4 to hit an unaware foe in melee or at short range; on a hit, damage is multiplied x2 at 1st, x3 at 5th, and x4 at 9th level.

bta_delver.name: Endurance
bta_delver.summary: Needs no rest every 6 turns while exploring; can force march 1 day plus 1 day per point of CON bonus without penalty (as Endurance proficiency).

bta_delver.name: Expert Caving
bta_delver.summary: Gauges length, width, and depth traveled almost without error; 9+ throw to recall the route taken if he was conscious (as Caving proficiency).

bta_delver.name: Shadowy Senses
bta_delver.summary: At combat/exploration speed, senses as if by a 30' dim candle; no colors, faces, or reading. Not when running, deaf, in bright light, or magic dark/silence.

bta_delver.name: Thief Skills
bta_delver.summary: Hide in shadows 17+, move silently 15+, climb walls 4+, find traps 14+, hear noises 12+ at 1st level, improving with level; cannot disarm traps.

bta_delver.name: Underdark Lore
bta_delver.summary: 9+ throw to identify edible or poisonous foods, healing herbs, and signs of unnatural danger underground (as Naturalism proficiency).

bta_delver.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_delver.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_delver.name: Hardy
bta_delver.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_delver.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_delver.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_delver.name: Renown
bta_delver.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 delvers of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_earthforger.name: Attention to Detail
bta_earthforger.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_earthforger.name: Deep Knowledge
bta_earthforger.summary: Expert in an earth or stone field (e.g. geology, architecture); earns up to 100gp/month; 2+ throw to recall expert lore (as 3 ranks of Knowledge).

bta_earthforger.name: Dwarven Throat-Singing
bta_earthforger.summary: +1 to perform invocations; earns 10gp/month singing; 11+ throw to identify famous singers and songs (as 1 rank of Performance).

bta_earthforger.name: Gnostic Magic
bta_earthforger.summary: Unlimited invocations, 1 turn each; throw 6+ at 1st (-1/level, +2 per invocation level over 1st); failure = stigma. Max level 1st, 2nd at 3rd ... 5th at 9th.

bta_earthforger.name: Extemporaneous Invocations
bta_earthforger.summary: Can improvise new invocations tailored to immediate needs by singing to earth and stone; harder to perform than known invocations.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of Creation
bta_earthforger.summary: Choose a sigil (Mountain's Bones, Eternal Forge, Iron Crucible, or Open Gate); it grants an invocation plus sigil features at 1st, 3rd, and 7th level.

bta_earthforger.name: Trinkets of Power
bta_earthforger.summary: Can create trinkets that store invocations for later use.

bta_earthforger.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_earthforger.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_earthforger.name: Hardy
bta_earthforger.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_earthforger.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_earthforger.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Mountain's Bones: Sigil Invocation
bta_earthforger.summary: Knows the Invocation of the Mountain's Bones (manipulating earth and stone, raising stone walls).

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Mountain's Bones: Lesser Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Climbs walls as a thief of his level (as Climbing proficiency).

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Eternal Forge: Sigil Invocation
bta_earthforger.summary: Knows the Invocation of the Eternal Forge (creating weapons, armor, and equipment fitted to himself).

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Eternal Forge: Lesser Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Counts as proficient with any axes or hammers he personally creates with the Invocation of the Eternal Forge.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Iron Crucible: Sigil Invocation
bta_earthforger.summary: Knows the Invocation of the Iron Crucible (conjuring constructs from earth and stone).

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Iron Crucible: Lesser Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Can wear chain mail or lighter armor.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Open Gate: Sigil Invocation
bta_earthforger.summary: Knows the Invocation of the Open Gate (animating and manipulating bone, flesh, and soul); a forbidden sigil.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Open Gate: Lesser Sigil Feature
