bta_earthforger.summary: Controls undead as a Chaotic cleric of half his level; foes take -2 on Death saves vs his invocations; +2 effective levels for death/necromantic effects.

bta_earthforger.name: Code of Behavior
bta_earthforger.summary: Must prefer to protect any work of art (2x normal value) and, whenever possible, any great art (100x); violation risks Corruption or loss of gnostic magic.

bta_earthforger.name: Greater Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Gains the second ability granted by his sigil.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Mountain's Bones: Greater Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: +4 on throws to bash doors and perform other feats of strength (as Dungeon Bashing proficiency).

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Eternal Forge: Greater Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Counts as proficient with any shields he personally creates with the Invocation of the Eternal Forge.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Iron Crucible: Greater Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Can wear any armor.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Open Gate: Greater Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Undead he controls stay controlled 1 day per level instead of 1 turn per level; a 'D' result makes control indefinite.

bta_earthforger.name: Greater Gnosis
bta_earthforger.summary: Learn one new invocation, or four spell effects of the Blast/Death/Healing/Protection/Summoning/Transmogrification/Wall types (-2 on research for items).

bta_earthforger.name: Minor Magical Research
bta_earthforger.summary: Can create talismans, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

bta_earthforger.name: Master Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Gains the third ability granted by his sigil.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Mountain's Bones: Master Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: Gains infravision to 30'.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Eternal Forge: Master Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: +1 initiative when wielding a self-made weapon and shield or wearing self-made armor from the Invocation of the Eternal Forge.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Iron Crucible: Master Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: 1 round: his constructs within 30' gain temp hp equal to the lower of 1/4 his or their hp, for 1 turn; usable once per day per level.

bta_earthforger.name: Sigil of the Open Gate: Master Sigil Feature
bta_earthforger.summary: 1 round: undead he made or controls within 30' gain temp hp equal to the lower of 1/4 his or their hp, for 1 turn; once per day per level.

bta_earthforger.name: Master Gnosis
bta_earthforger.summary: Learn another invocation, or four more spell effects of the Blast/Death/Healing/Protection/Summoning/Transmogrification/Wall types, as Greater Gnosis.

bta_earthforger.name: Major Magical Research
bta_earthforger.summary: Can craft magical constructs such as golems; Sigil of the Open Gate earthforgers can also create undead.

bta_earthforger.name: Renown
bta_earthforger.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 earthforgers of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_excavator.name: Attention to Detail
bta_excavator.summary: +2 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_excavator.name: Expert Caving
bta_excavator.summary: Gauges length, width, and depth traveled almost without error; 9+ throw to recall the route taken if he was conscious (as Caving proficiency).

bta_excavator.name: Loadbearing
bta_excavator.summary: Reduces his effective encumbrance by 2 stone when determining movement rate.

bta_excavator.name: Mine Working
bta_excavator.summary: Counts as a skilled mining laborer (2sp/day construction rate); force marches 1 day plus 1 per CON bonus point (as Labor proficiency).

bta_excavator.name: Prospecting
bta_excavator.summary: 1 day and a 15+ throw to learn if a 6-mile hex holds minable ore; +4 if he has Land Surveying (as Prospecting proficiency).

bta_excavator.name: Pyroclastics
bta_excavator.summary: Attacks as a vaultguard with burning oil and petards; save vs Paralysis to avoid fumble mishaps; +1 damage, +1 more at 3rd, 6th, 9th; can cleave with oil.

bta_excavator.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_excavator.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_excavator.name: Hardy
bta_excavator.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_excavator.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_excavator.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_excavator.name: Dowsing
bta_excavator.summary: With a rod, concentrate 1 round and throw 6+ (2+ by 7th) plus INT to point to nearest precious metal within 240'; 1 turn gives +4; +4 to prospecting.

bta_excavator.name: Mine Management
bta_excavator.summary: Personally managing a mine (20 days/month) adds 1gp labor revenue per mining family; he must rule the domain or have the ruler's permission.

bta_excavator.name: Engineering
bta_excavator.summary: 9+ throw to evaluate constructions; can plan and supervise construction projects of up to 100,000gp (as 4 ranks of Engineering).

bta_excavator.name: Industrialism
bta_excavator.summary: Makes Industrial improvements to mines at half the normal cost and time, up to +6gp labor value per family.

bta_excavator.name: Renown
bta_excavator.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 excavators of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_excavator.name: Deep Delving
bta_excavator.summary: When personally managing a mine that is delving deep, the Judge rolls twice on the Vagaries of the Deep table and uses the better result.

bta_furnacewife.name: Attention to Detail
bta_furnacewife.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_furnacewife.name: Crafting
bta_furnacewife.summary: Master of a fire craft (e.g. smithing, smelting): 40gp/month, supervises 2 journeymen and 4 apprentices; 8+ to identify works (as 3 ranks of Craft).

bta_furnacewife.name: Dwarven Throat-Singing
bta_furnacewife.summary: +1 to perform invocations; earns 10gp/month singing; 8+ throw to identify famous singers and songs (as 1 rank of Performance).

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Cauterization
bta_furnacewife.summary: Heals herself or a touched creature for 2 hp per level (as a rank of Laying on Hands).

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Resistance
bta_furnacewife.summary: Immune to minor heat and fire; +2 saves vs major fire, and -1 damage per die from it (minimum 1 per die).

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Torch
bta_furnacewife.summary: Torch-shaped talisman she lights or douses in lieu of moving; lit, it acts as a +1 elemental fire talisman; bonus can grow via Personal Talisman.

bta_furnacewife.name: Gnostic Magic
bta_furnacewife.summary: Unlimited Invocation of the Maker's Fire, 1 turn each; throw 6+ at 1st (-1/level, +2 per inv. level over 1st). Max level 1st, 2nd at 3rd ... 5th at 9th.

bta_furnacewife.name: Trinkets of Power
bta_furnacewife.summary: Can create trinkets that store invocations for later use.

bta_furnacewife.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_furnacewife.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_furnacewife.name: Hardy
bta_furnacewife.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_furnacewife.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_furnacewife.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_furnacewife.name: Code of Behavior
bta_furnacewife.summary: Never uses magic to harm a Lawful sapient except in self-defense or defense of dwarves; must defend dwarven women and children at all costs, even her life.

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Speed
bta_furnacewife.summary: +1 initiative when using gnostic magic; counts as 2 levels higher to dispel magic or penetrate magic resistance (as Battle Magic).

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Aura
bta_furnacewife.summary: +2 on reaction rolls to impress or intimidate; a total of 12+ makes subjects act as if charmed in her presence (as Mystic Aura).

bta_furnacewife.name: Minor Magical Research
bta_furnacewife.summary: Can create talismans, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Will
bta_furnacewife.summary: If damage or interruption makes an invocation fail, she keeps her action and may act and move normally; failure effects still apply (as Unflappable Casting).

bta_furnacewife.name: Fiery Blessing
bta_furnacewife.summary: +2 to all saving throws (already in the table); if Adult or Middle Age, she becomes able to bear children despite prior mortal wounds.

bta_furnacewife.name: Major Magical Research
bta_furnacewife.summary: Can craft magical constructs such as golems.

bta_furnacewife.name: Renown
bta_furnacewife.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 furnacewives of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_fury.name: Flesh-Runes
bta_fury.summary: +2 AC (no armor; stacks with rings/potions of protection) and -1 damage per die from nonmagical attacks; monsters of 5+ HD count as magical.

bta_fury.name: Fighting Fury
bta_fury.summary: Rage at any point in his initiative (no action): +2 damage, immune to fear; cannot retreat, withdraw, or move away from foes. Lasts until combat ends.

bta_fury.name: Intimidation
bta_fury.summary: +2 on reaction rolls when threatening violence or dire consequences; targets must be 5 HD or less, or outnumbered/outranked (as Intimidation).

bta_fury.name: Savage Resilience
bta_fury.summary: Rolls twice on the Mortal Wounds table and picks the result; subtracts his class level from any days of bed rest required.

bta_fury.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_fury.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_fury.name: Hardy
bta_fury.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_fury.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_fury.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_fury.name: Battlefield Prowess
bta_fury.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he personally leads gain +1 morale; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

bta_fury.name: Improved Flesh-Runes
bta_fury.summary: Flesh-runes now give +4 AC and -2 damage per die from nonmagical attacks; only monsters of 11+ HD count as magical.

bta_fury.name: Renown
bta_fury.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 furies of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_fury.name: Superior Flesh-Runes
bta_fury.summary: Flesh-runes now give +6 AC and -3 damage per die from nonmagical attacks; only monsters of 17+ HD count as magical.

bta_machinist.name: Attention to Detail
bta_machinist.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_machinist.name: Ballistics Expertise
bta_machinist.summary: Attacks as a vaultguard when crewing ballistae, catapults, trebuchets, or ranged automaton weapons; +1 damage, +1 more at 3rd, 6th, and 9th.

bta_machinist.name: Crafting
bta_machinist.summary: Master craftsman: 40gp/month, supervises 2 journeymen and 4 apprentices, 8+ to identify works; +50gp/day to automaton construction (as 3 ranks of Craft).

bta_machinist.name: Design, Build, and Repair Automatons
bta_machinist.summary: Pays material and labor costs, then throws 14+ at 1st (5+ at 10th) to design, build, or repair automatons; construction rate 5gp/day at 1st, rising.

bta_machinist.name: Mechanic Knowledge
bta_machinist.summary: Opens locks 15+, finds traps 14+, and removes traps 15+ at 1st level, improving with level, as a thief.

bta_machinist.name: Personal Automaton
bta_machinist.summary: Starts with a personal automaton worth up to 7,000gp material and labor; only he can maintain it (5gp/day auto); replacements cost 7,000gp less.

bta_machinist.name: Siege Engineering
bta_machinist.summary: Builds temporary field defenses and builds and operates siege engines and war machines (as 2 ranks of Siege Engineering).

bta_machinist.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_machinist.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_machinist.name: Hardy
bta_machinist.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_machinist.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_machinist.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_machinist.name: Renown
bta_machinist.summary: With a manufactory (as a mage's sanctum), attracts 1d6 apprentice machinists of 1st-3rd level and 2d6 dwarven engineers; apprentices need only food and lodging.

bta_pugilist.name: Attention to Detail
bta_pugilist.summary: +1 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned.

bta_pugilist.name: Combat Trickery
bta_pugilist.summary: Pick one maneuver (disarm, force back, knock down, overrun, sunder, wrestle): its penalty is reduced by 2 and the foe saves at -2 (as Combat Trickery).

bta_pugilist.name: Endurance
bta_pugilist.summary: Needs no rest every 6 turns while exploring; can force march 1 day plus 1 day per point of CON bonus without penalty (as Endurance proficiency).

bta_pugilist.name: Intimidation
bta_pugilist.summary: +2 on reaction rolls when threatening violence or dire consequences; targets must be 5 HD or less, or outnumbered/outranked (as Intimidation).

bta_pugilist.name: Pugilism
bta_pugilist.summary: Two bare-handed attacks per round, 1d3 each (plus STR) at 1st; lethal or nonlethal; no harm from punching metal armor; may use Weapon Finesse with fists.

bta_pugilist.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_pugilist.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_pugilist.name: Hardy
bta_pugilist.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_pugilist.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_pugilist.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_pugilist.name: Legwork
bta_pugilist.summary: +1 AC in leather or lighter armor while lightly encumbered or less; rises to +2 at 4th, +3 at 6th, +4 at 8th, +5 at 10th, +6 at 12th.

bta_pugilist.name: Old Man Bones
bta_pugilist.summary: Fist damage becomes 1d4 per blow; rises to 1d6 at 5th, 1d8 at 7th, 1d10 at 9th, and 1d12 at 11th level.

bta_pugilist.name: Eye of the Tiger
bta_pugilist.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he personally leads gain +1 morale; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

bta_pugilist.name: Magic Hands
bta_pugilist.summary: His fists count as magical weapons for damaging creatures harmed only by magic.

bta_pugilist.name: Skirmishing
bta_pugilist.summary: Can withdraw or retreat from melee without declaring it before initiative (as Skirmishing proficiency).

bta_pugilist.name: Hard to Kill
bta_pugilist.summary: Rolls twice on the Mortal Wounds table and picks the result; subtracts his class level from any days of bed rest required.

bta_pugilist.name: Renown
bta_pugilist.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 pugilists of 1st-3rd level to train at his hall; they are paid normal rates.

bta_pugilist.name: Second Wind
bta_pugilist.summary: Once per day, spends an action instead of attacking to regain 20 hp; unusable while unconscious or otherwise unable to act.

bta_pugilist.name: Unyielding Spirit
bta_pugilist.summary: +1 to all saves (in table); at 0 hp or less may fight on up to 4 rounds, at -2/-5/-10 on Mortal Wounds for 1/2/3 rounds; dies after the 4th.

bta_rhetor.name: Attention to Detail
bta_rhetor.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_rhetor.name: Endurance
bta_rhetor.summary: Needs no rest every 6 turns while exploring; can force march 1 day plus 1 day per point of CON bonus without penalty (as Endurance proficiency).

bta_rhetor.name: Linguistics
bta_rhetor.summary: Speaks, reads, and writes 4 extra languages; 2+ to read ciphers or foreign/ancient writing (a failed text can be retried only at a higher level).

bta_rhetor.name: Jurisprudence
bta_rhetor.summary: 8+ for expert legal commentary; earns 100gp/month as an attorney, supervising 2 practitioners and 4 apprentices at +50% output (as 3 ranks of Profession).

bta_rhetor.name: Loremastery
bta_rhetor.summary: 15+ at 1st, improving by 1 per level, to decipher runes, recall history or lore, or identify artifacts (as Loremastery proficiency).

bta_rhetor.name: Inspire Courage
bta_rhetor.summary: 1-round oration before battle: allies in 50' get +1 to attacks, damage, morale, and saves vs fear for 1 turn; once per day per level per character.

bta_rhetor.name: Performance
bta_rhetor.summary: Earns 10gp/month from speeches; 8+ to identify renowned rhetors and speeches; each extra Performance rank gives +1 to Rhetoric throws (max +2).

bta_rhetor.name: Rhetoric
bta_rhetor.summary: Knows 2 rhetorical effects (1st-level enchantments, e.g. charm person, sleep); Rhetoric throw 8+ at 1st (2+ by 7th) vs listeners not in combat.

bta_rhetor.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_rhetor.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_rhetor.name: Hardy
bta_rhetor.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_rhetor.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_rhetor.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_rhetor.name: Tireless
bta_rhetor.summary: Needs only 4 hours of rest per day; force marching moves at 200% rather than 150% of the normal rate.

bta_rhetor.name: Renown
bta_rhetor.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 rhetors of 1st-3rd level within 1d3 months; they are paid normal rates.

bta_rhetor.name: Rule of Law
bta_rhetor.summary: Personally adjudicating a domain's courts (20 days/month) adds 1gp revenue per urban family; he must rule or have the ruler's permission.

bta_sporecaster.name: Attention to Detail
bta_sporecaster.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for every proficiency learned (already included in class abilities).

bta_sporecaster.name: Alchemy
bta_sporecaster.summary: 2+ to identify potions by taste; brews potions as an arcane caster of his level; magic research for new brews (13+ at 1st); +3 to Dwarven Brewing.

bta_sporecaster.name: Conventional Brewing
bta_sporecaster.summary: Brews 10gp/month of ales and beers; 8+ to identify famous brews and brewers; +1 to Dwarven Brewing (as 1 rank of Craft).

bta_sporecaster.name: Dwarven Brewing
bta_sporecaster.summary: Makes dwarven mushroom brews with equipment, piltbier, and special mushrooms; throw 9+ at 1st (1+ at 9th); knows clubhead plus 4 other recipes.

bta_sporecaster.name: Fungal Friendship
bta_sporecaster.summary: 8+ to identify a fungus, mold, or ooze by touch; +2 on reactions with them; can take them as henchmen and command them at touch range.

bta_sporecaster.name: Fungal Immunity
bta_sporecaster.summary: Immune to fungal and mold toxins and yellow mold spores; no bad dwarven brew effects; unharmed by black puddings, gelatinous cubes, gray ooze, green slime.

bta_sporecaster.name: Necrosporing
bta_sporecaster.summary: 1 turn touching a corpse makes a spore zombie (plant); total HD 8 at 1st per table, none over 2x his HD; rots in 1 day unless dosed with clubhead brew.

bta_sporecaster.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_sporecaster.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_sporecaster.name: Hardy
bta_sporecaster.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_sporecaster.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_sporecaster.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_sporecaster.name: Fungal Awareness
bta_sporecaster.summary: Concentrate 1 turn to detect fungus, molds, slimes, and oozes within 60'; lasts while concentrating, and he may move at half speed.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Fungal Communion
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Contact other plane with the great fungi once per week; may swap madness for a random Gift.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Kiss of Life
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Animates a spore zombie in 1 round by breath; it rots in 1 hour unless dosed.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Mushroom Overlord
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Any sapient race can work his mushroom farms as work-gangs; forced gangs cut morale.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Rotless Rot
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. No aging ability penalties; failing an aging Death save gives a mutation, not death.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Secretion
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Exudes one known dwarven brew's effect by touch, cast like a spell; can be taken repeatedly.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Spore Calibration
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Spore zombies can work farms or mines; 5 equal 1 family; never rebel.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Spore Fermentation
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. 1 turn makes a zombie explosive: 2d6 in 10' when destroyed (Blast save half).

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Spore Perception
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. Uses the senses of one spore zombie or sporecalled henchman in spore range.

bta_sporecaster.name: Optional: Spore Synchronization
bta_sporecaster.summary: Wet path pick at 2nd/4th/6th/8th, rolls a Gift of the Great Fungi. His spore zombies in control range act on his initiative, not last.

bta_sporecaster.name: Blooming Spores
bta_sporecaster.summary: Range to identify mycoflora and command sporecalled henchmen and spore zombies rises to 15'; spores smell faintly of soil; fails in high winds.

bta_sporecaster.name: Fungal Humors
bta_sporecaster.summary: Immune to all diseases and poisons.

bta_sporecaster.name: Blossoming Spores
bta_sporecaster.summary: Spore communication and command range rises to 30' (still fails in high winds).

bta_sporecaster.name: Mushroom Management
bta_sporecaster.summary: Personally managing mushroom farms (20 days/month) adds 1gp land revenue per piltgarin family; he must rule or have the ruler's permission.

bta_sporecaster.name: Billowing Spores
bta_sporecaster.summary: Spore communication and command range rises to 60' (still fails in high winds).

bta_sporecaster.name: Spore Servitude
bta_sporecaster.summary: Controls creatures affected by clubhead brew or secretion, and vagary-made spore zombies, as his own; takes another's only if higher level.

bta_sporecaster.name: Mushroom Mutation
bta_sporecaster.summary: When personally managing experimental mushroom farms, the Judge rolls twice on Vagaries of Mycocultural Mutation and he picks the result.

bta_sporecaster.name: Renown
bta_sporecaster.summary: With a mycenium (as a mage's sanctum), attracts 1d6 apprentice sporecasters of 1st-3rd level plus 2d6 aspiring dwarves; apprentices need only food and lodging.

bta_sporecaster.name: Fungal Spawn
bta_sporecaster.summary: Creates fungal crossbreeds as an 11th-level mage (one progenitor must be fungus, mold, or ooze); results are Friendly and recruitable; may crossbreed himself.

bta_tombsealer.name: Undead Slaying
bta_tombsealer.summary: +1 to attack throws vs undead; 11+ to identify an undead creature's abilities and vulnerabilities from its appearance.

bta_tombsealer.name: Detect Evil
bta_tombsealer.summary: Detects evil as the spell to 60' by concentrating 1 turn; evil includes all undead, summoned creatures, and hostile Chaotic beings.

bta_tombsealer.name: Lesser Rite of Sealing
bta_tombsealer.summary: Once per 8 hours, a 1-round rite seals a door, portal, or chest as wizard lock; maintains seals up to his level; seals end at his death.

bta_tombsealer.name: Manual of Arms
bta_tombsealer.summary: Trains up to 60 dwarven conscripts into heavy infantry in one month (as 1 rank of Manual of Arms).

bta_tombsealer.name: Dwarf Tongues
bta_tombsealer.summary: Speaks Common and Dwarvish, plus Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

bta_tombsealer.name: Hardy
bta_tombsealer.summary: Save targets are 3 lower vs Blast/Breath and 4 lower vs all other saves (already included in the saving throw table).

bta_tombsealer.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
bta_tombsealer.summary: +1 to surprise rolls underground; 14+ to find traps, false walls, hidden construction, and sloping passages when searching; hears noises on 14+.

bta_tombsealer.name: Aura of Protection
bta_tombsealer.summary: +1 AC and +1 on saves vs attacks and effects of evil creatures; shows as a golden halo to detect good, detect magic, or true seeing.

bta_tombsealer.name: Battlefield Prowess
bta_tombsealer.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he personally leads gain +1 morale; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

bta_tombsealer.name: Stalwart Soul
bta_tombsealer.summary: Immune to energy drain, mummy rot, and undead aging; never rises as undead and his remains cannot be made undead.

bta_tombsealer.name: Rite of Discovery
bta_tombsealer.summary: Once per week, a 1-turn rite senses direction and distance to nearest undead (or a known one) within 12 miles; lead or gold blocks it (locate haunting).

bta_tombsealer.name: Greater Rite of Sealing
bta_tombsealer.summary: Once per week, a 1-round rite permanently seals a door, portal, or chest (persists after his death); each use lowers his max seals by 1 for good.

bta_tombsealer.name: Renown
bta_tombsealer.summary: With a vault domain, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 tombsealers of 1st-3rd level; they are paid normal mercenary rates.

fighter.name: Manual of Arms
fighter.summary: Knows homeland's military gear, standards, slang, ranks; 11+ for other realms. Fights as a regular in formed/loose units. = Manual of Arms 1 rank.

fighter.name: Battlefield Prowess
fighter.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he hires get +1 morale while he personally leads them; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

fighter.name: Castle
fighter.summary: With a 15,000gp+ castle or fort, gains 5d6x10 0th-level troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level fighters within 1d3 months; must pay normal wages.

explorer.name: Alertness
explorer.summary: +1 to avoid surprise. Adventuring searches/listening succeed on 14+ (not 18+), or +2 if he has Searching/Listening proficiency.

explorer.name: Ambushing
explorer.summary: Vs. vulnerable foes in melee or short-range missile: +4 to hit and +1 damage die. Equivalent to Ambushing proficiency.

explorer.name: Animal Reflexes
explorer.summary: +1 initiative and +1 to avoid surprise (stacks with Alertness for +2 surprise total).

explorer.name: Endurance
explorer.summary: No need to rest every 6 turns while exploring; force march 1 day without penalty, +1 day per CON bonus. Equivalent to Endurance proficiency.

explorer.name: Evasion
explorer.summary: Guiding party in familiar territory: +5 to evade wilderness encounters, and can evade even when the party is surprised if he is not.

explorer.name: Pathfinding
explorer.summary: Guiding party in familiar territory: +4 to avoid getting lost. Familiar radius = settled lands + 1 24-mile hex per level.

explorer.name: Natural Stealth
explorer.summary: Foes take -2 on surprise rolls when he approaches from out of line of sight or lies in wait in cover or darkness.

explorer.name: Experience and Hardiness
explorer.summary: Hirelings on a wilderness adventure he leads get +1 morale; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

explorer.name: Border Fort
explorer.summary: 15,000gp+ fort in outlands/unsettled land: 5d6x10 troops + 1d6 1st-3rd lvl explorers in 1d3 months. Within 24mi never lost, +4 more to evade.

thief.name: Backstabbing
thief.summary: Vs. vulnerable foes in melee or short-range missile: +4 to hit and +1 damage die; extra die at 5th, 9th, and 13th level (up to +4d).

thief.name: Climbing
thief.summary: Thief skill: Climbing throw 6+ at 1st level per 100' climbed (improves by level). -5 at half combat speed, -10 at full; failure means a fall.

thief.name: Hiding
thief.summary: Thief skill: Hiding 19+ at 1st level (improves by level), rolled secretly in cover/dim light/darkness. Hidden = no line of sight; foes -2 surprise regardless.

thief.name: Listening
thief.summary: Thief skill: Listening 14+ at 1st level (improves by level), rolled secretly. Hears noises beyond doors/passages; 1 round, once per turn if moving.

thief.name: Lockpicking
thief.summary: Thief skill: Lockpicking 18+ at 1st level (improves by level). Hasty: 1 round, nat 1-3 jams lock. Methodical: 1 turn at +4, nat 1 jams. Needs thieves' tools.

thief.name: Pickpocketing
thief.summary: Thief skill: Pickpocketing 17+ at 1st level (improves by level), within 5'; +4 if target unaware. Nat 1 or under half the target: noticed, reaction at -3.

thief.name: Searching
thief.summary: Thief skill: Searching 18+ at 1st level (improves by level), secret roll, finds hidden features within 5'. Hasty: 1 round. Methodical: 1 turn at +4.

thief.name: Shadowy Senses
thief.summary: At combat or exploration speed, senses as if carrying a 30' dim light. No colors, faces, or reading; fails if charging/running, deafened, or in bright light.

thief.name: Sneaking
thief.summary: Thief skill: Sneaking 17+ at 1st level (improves by level), secret roll; silent movement. -5 above half combat speed, -10 running; foes -2 surprise regardless.

thief.name: Streetwise
thief.summary: Knows criminal signs, slang, and turf of home settlement; 11+ for other cities. Can do hijinks; may start in a thieves' guild. = Streetwise 1 rank.

thief.name: Trapbreaking
thief.summary: Thief skill: Trapbreaking 18+ at 1st level (improves by level). Hasty: 1 round, nat 1-3 sets it off. Methodical: 1 turn at +4, nat 1 sets it off. Needs tools.

thief.name: Deciphering
thief.summary: Decipher ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages (not magic) on 4+ on 1d20, 1 turn per page; a failed page can't be retried until next level.

thief.name: Hideout
thief.summary: With a 5,000gp+ hideout, 2d6 1st-level thieves join within 1d4 weeks (paid as ruffians, one is a rival's spy). Can found a criminal syndicate.

thief.name: Scrollreading
thief.summary: Can cast from arcane and divine scrolls on 4+ on 1d20 (1 round); must have deciphered the text. Failure can backfire horribly at Judge's discretion.

mage.name: Arcane Magic
mage.summary: Casts arcane spells per Mage Spell Progression (1 1st-level spell/day at 1st level, up to 6th-level spells). Repertoire = slots + INT bonus per spell level.

mage.name: Collegiate Wizardry
mage.summary: Knows symbols, spell signatures, and grimoires of his own arcane order; 11+ for other traditions. May start in a wizards' guild. = Collegiate Wizardry 1 rank.

mage.name: Minor Magical Research
mage.summary: Can research new spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

mage.name: Major Magical Research
mage.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

mage.name: Sanctum
mage.summary: With a 15,000gp+ sanctum, 1d6 1st-3rd lvl and 2d6 0th-lvl apprentices join in 1d3 months as research assistants (food/lodging only). Dungeon draws monsters.

mage.name: Supreme Magical Research
mage.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells, build constructs, and make crossbreeds; if chaotic, can create necromantic servants and become undead.

crusader.name: Divine Magic
crusader.summary: Casts divine spells from his order's repertoire per Crusader Spell Progression (1 1st-level spell/day at 1st level, up to 6th-level spells).

crusader.name: Theology
crusader.summary: Knows symbols, rites, and holy days of his faith; 11+ for other faiths. Can gain congregants by proselytizing; may start in a hierarchy. = Theology 1 rank.

crusader.name: Rebuke Undead
crusader.summary: Throw per Rebuking table (skeletons 10+ at 1st; becomes auto R/D by level); success rebukes 2d6 HD (min 1) of undead for 1 turn. Chaotic sects may control.

crusader.name: Code of Behavior
crusader.summary: Must keep his order's strictures (Ammonar: show winged sun, 1hr dawn prayer, no bladed/blood-shedding weapons, obey just laws) or face disfavor.

crusader.name: Minor Magical Research
crusader.summary: Can scribe magical scrolls and brew potions.

crusader.name: Major Magical Research
crusader.summary: Can create permanent magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

crusader.name: Fortified Church
crusader.summary: 15,000gp+ church (half cost if true to code): 5d6x10 troops + 1d6 1st-3rd lvl crusaders in 1d3 months, loyalty +4 and morale +4; must pay fair wages.

crusader.name: Supreme Magical Research
crusader.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual divine spells and craft constructs (golems, statues); if chaotic, create necromantic servants and become undead.

venturer.name: Bribery
venturer.summary: Bribes add +1 to reaction for a day's pay, +2 for a week's, +3 for a month's; deniable, only chargeable on an unmodified 2 on 2d6.

venturer.name: Diplomacy
venturer.summary: +1 to reaction rolls when parleying with intelligent creatures. Equivalent to Diplomacy proficiency.

venturer.name: Expert Bargaining
venturer.summary: Buys at 10% under and sells at 10% over list price; opposed reaction roll vs. other bargainers (+2 on it). Equivalent to Bargaining 1 rank.

venturer.name: Expert Traveling
venturer.summary: Begins play with his choice of Driving or Seafaring proficiency.

venturer.name: Mercantile Network
venturer.summary: In any market visited before, treat it as one class larger (Class I stays I) or take +1 market impact. Doesn't affect passive investments.

venturer.name: Multilingual
venturer.summary: Gains 3 bonus languages, chosen now from the starting region or later from those met in play.

venturer.name: Pathfinding
venturer.summary: Guiding party in familiar territory: +4 to avoid getting lost. Familiar radius = settled lands + 1 24-mile hex per level.

venturer.name: Treachery
venturer.summary: After a Friendly reaction via Diplomacy/Bribery, can strike so all within 30' roll surprise at -3. Party exempt if signaled/planned. Fails vs. another venturer.

venturer.name: Steady Trade Route
venturer.summary: Set up a route for 2 merchandise types between 2 visited markets; add half level (round up) to market impact there. +1 passive investment.

venturer.name: Rumormongering
venturer.summary: Learns 1d4 rumors from contacts on revisiting an urban settlement he has traded in; takes 1 day, once per month per settlement.

venturer.name: Steady Trade Route
venturer.summary: Gains a second steady trade route (new markets and/or merchandise), with its market impact bonus and +1 passive investment.

venturer.name: Access to Capital
venturer.summary: Borrow from the merchant guild at 3%/month unsecured or 1%/month with collateral, limited by market pool. Missed interest makes him disreputable there.

venturer.name: Guildhouse
venturer.summary: 5,000gp+ guildhouse: 2d6 1st-lvl venturers join in 1d4 weeks (one a spy). Extra passive investments = value / market max. As syndicate = half-value hideout.

venturer.name: Steady Trade Route
venturer.summary: Gains a third steady trade route (new markets and/or merchandise), with its market impact bonus and +1 passive investment.

venturer.name: Monopoly Power
venturer.summary: With a guildhouse in a settlement, earn 1gp/month per urban family there as monopoly revenue; rival venturers must be eliminated or bargained with.

assassin.name: Backstabbing
assassin.summary: Vs. vulnerable foes in melee or short-range missile: +4 to hit and +1 damage die; extra die at 5th, 9th, 13th (up to +4d). Light armor or less only.

assassin.name: Hiding
assassin.summary: Hiding 19+ at 1st level (improves by level), secret roll in cover/dim light/darkness; hidden = no line of sight, foes -2 surprise. Light armor or less.

assassin.name: Shadowy Senses
assassin.summary: At combat/exploration speed, senses as if carrying a 30' dim light. No colors, faces, or reading; fails if charging/running, deafened, or magical dark/silence.

assassin.name: Sneaking
assassin.summary: Sneaking 17+ at 1st level (improves by level), secret roll; silent movement. -5 above half combat speed, -10 running; foes -2 surprise. Light armor or less.

assassin.name: Streetwise
assassin.summary: Knows criminal signs, slang, and turf of home settlement; 11+ for other cities. Can do hijinks; may start in an assassins' guild. = Streetwise 1 rank.

assassin.name: Hideout
assassin.summary: With a 5,000gp+ hideout, 2d6 1st-level assassins join within 1d4 weeks (paid as henchmen, one is a rival's spy). Can found a criminal syndicate.

barbarian.name: Animal Reflexes
barbarian.summary: +1 bonus to initiative and +1 bonus to avoid surprise.

barbarian.name: Natural Proficiency
barbarian.summary: Free bonus proficiencies by region: Jutland Climbing + Seafaring; Skysostan Precise Shooting + Riding; Ivory Kingdoms Running + Endurance.

barbarian.name: Natural Stealth
barbarian.summary: Foes take -2 on surprise rolls when he approaches from out of line of sight or lies in wait in cover or darkness.

barbarian.name: Savage Resilience
barbarian.summary: Rolls twice on the Mortal Wounds table and picks the result; subtracts class level from days of bed rest needed to recover.

barbarian.name: Animal Magnetism
barbarian.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he hires get +1 morale while he personally leads them; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

barbarian.name: Chieftain's Hall
barbarian.summary: With a 15,000gp+ chieftain's hall, gains 5d6x10 0th-level troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level barbarians within 1d3 months; must pay normal wages.

bard.name: Arcane Dabbling
bard.summary: Can use wands, staffs and other arcane-only magic items without knowing command words on a 4+ proficiency throw; failure backfires (Judge's call).

bard.name: Inspire Courage
bard.summary: 1 round of oration: up to 30 allies in 50' get +1 to attacks, AC, morale and saves vs fear for 1 turn. Once/day per level; not usable once engaged.

bard.name: Jack of All Trades
bard.summary: Learn one class proficiency from any class, a thief skill (not backstab), a venturer power (not mercantile network), or a Judge-approved non-spell power.

bard.name: Listening
bard.summary: Judge rolls in secret for the bard to hear noises: 14+ at 1st, improving by 1 per level (1+ at 14th). Takes 1 round; once per turn if the party moves.

bard.name: Loremastery
bard.summary: Decipher runes, recall history, identify artifacts or monster parts on 18+, improving 1/level (5+ at 14th); identifies magic items as a 5th level mage.

bard.name: Multilingual
bard.summary: Gains three bonus languages, picked now from those common in the starting region or later from ones met in play (one rank of Language).

bard.name: Performance
bard.summary: Trained performer: earns 10gp/month entertaining; identifies renowned performers, famous works and unusual songs on 11+ (one rank of Performance).

bard.name: Jack of All Trades II
bard.summary: Learn another class proficiency from any class, a thief skill (not backstab), a venturer power (not mercantile network), or a Judge-approved non-spell power.

bard.name: Deciphering
bard.summary: Decipher ciphers, treasure maps and dead languages (not magical writing): 1 turn per page, 4+ on 1d20; a failed page can't be retried until next level.

bard.name: Chronicles of Battle
bard.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries hired by the bard gain +1 morale while he is present to witness their deeds; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

bard.name: Jack of All Trades III
bard.summary: Learn another class proficiency from any class, a thief skill (not backstab), a venturer power (not mercantile network), or a Judge-approved non-spell power.

bard.name: Inspire Hope
bard.summary: 1 round: up to 30 allies in 30' gain temp hp (1d2 to 6d10+ by lower max hp of bard or ally) for 1 turn. 1/day at 7th, +1/day per level after.

bard.name: Jack of All Trades IV
bard.summary: Learn another class proficiency from any class, a thief skill (not backstab), a venturer power (not mercantile network), or a Judge-approved non-spell power.

bard.name: Great Hall
bard.summary: With a 15,000gp+ great hall, attracts 5d6x10 0th level troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level bards within 1d3 months; they must be paid normal wages.

bard.name: Scrollreading
bard.summary: Can cast spells from arcane and divine scrolls (once deciphered): 1 round and 4+ on 1d20; failure makes the spell misfire, possibly horribly.

bard.name: Jack of All Trades V
bard.summary: Learn another class proficiency from any class, a thief skill (not backstab), a venturer power (not mercantile network), or a Judge-approved non-spell power.

bladedancer.name: Graceful Fighting
bladedancer.summary: In light, very light or no armor and 5 st or less: +1 initiative and +1 AC (AC +2 at 7th, +3 at 13th). Swashbuckling stacks, capped at +1 unless unarmored.

bladedancer.name: Divine Magic
bladedancer.summary: Casts divine spells from her order's repertoire; spells per day by level follow the Bladedancer Spell Progression table (up to 6th level spells).

bladedancer.name: Strength of Faith
bladedancer.summary: May apply her WIL modifier instead of her STR modifier to any damage roll affected by STR.

bladedancer.name: Theology
bladedancer.summary: Auto-identifies symbols, spell signatures and holy days of own faith, other faiths on 11+; may join a hierarchy and gain congregants (one rank of Theology).

bladedancer.name: Weapon Finesse
bladedancer.summary: Uses DEX modifier instead of STR on melee attack throws with weapons she is proficient with; does not stack with the Weapon Finesse proficiency.

bladedancer.name: Code of Behavior
bladedancer.summary: Must carry a weapon, pray to Ianna at dawn or dusk (1 hr), shun axes, hammers, bows, slings and shields, not wed before 7th; violations anger her goddess.

bladedancer.name: Minor Magical Research
bladedancer.summary: Can scribe scrolls and brew potions.

bladedancer.name: Major Magical Research
bladedancer.summary: Can create permanent magic items such as enchanted armor, rings, and weapons.

bladedancer.name: Temple
bladedancer.summary: With a 15,000gp+ temple (half price if in favor), attracts 5d6x10 0th level troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level bladedancers; loyalty +4, morale +4; must be paid.

bladedancer.name: Supreme Magical Research
bladedancer.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual divine spells and craft magical constructs; if chaotic, can create necromantic servants and become undead.

paladin.name: Aura of Protection
paladin.summary: +1 AC and +1 to saving throws against attacks and effects of evil creatures; appears as a golden halo to discern good, discern magic or true seeing.

paladin.name: Lay on Hands
paladin.summary: Once/day: heal 2 hp per level, add half level (round up) to a Mortal Wounds throw, or cure paralysis. Extra uses via Laying on Hands proficiency.

paladin.name: Manual of Arms
paladin.summary: Auto-identifies homeland military standards, gear, captains and insignia; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed and loose units.

paladin.name: Sanctified Body
paladin.summary: Completely immune to disease, including magical diseases (equivalent to Divine Health proficiency).

paladin.name: Sense Evil
paladin.summary: After 1 round of concentration, sees evil creatures, items and undead within 45' in line of sight for up to 1 round/level; once per turn (as Sensing Evil).

paladin.name: Holy Fervor
paladin.summary: Hirelings of the paladin's religion gain +1 morale whenever he personally leads them; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

paladin.name: Fortress
paladin.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fortress, attracts 5d6x10 0th level troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level paladins within 1d3 months; they must be paid normal wages.

priestess.name: Consolation
priestess.summary: 1 turn of prayer and counsel doubles a creature's natural healing from rest for the next day; only sapient targets of her alignment and religion.

priestess.name: Diplomacy
priestess.summary: +1 bonus on reaction rolls when parleying with intelligent creatures (equivalent to Diplomacy proficiency).

priestess.name: Divine Magic
priestess.summary: Casts divine spells from her order's repertoire; spells per day by level follow the Priestess Spell Progression table (up to 6th level spells).

priestess.name: Lay on Hands
priestess.summary: Once/day: heal 2 hp per level, add half level (round up) to a Mortal Wounds throw, or cure paralysis. Extra uses via Laying on Hands proficiency.

priestess.name: Purity of the Body
priestess.summary: Immune to all disease, including magical diseases from spells, mummies or lycanthropes (equivalent to Divine Health proficiency).

priestess.name: Theology
priestess.summary: Auto-identifies symbols, spell signatures and holy days of own faith, other faiths on 11+; may join a hierarchy and gain congregants (one rank of Theology).

priestess.name: Code of Behavior
priestess.summary: Wear white mantles in public, pray at dusk (1 hr), keep a flame lit every 7th night, never kill humans/demi-humans, chaste until 7th; else penalties.

priestess.name: Minor Magical Research
priestess.summary: Can scribe magical scrolls and brew potions.

priestess.name: Cloister
priestess.summary: With a 15,000gp+ cloister (matriarch may pay half), attracts 1d2x10 1st level priestesses and 1d6x30 women trainees in 1d3 months; 80% of trainees leave yearly.

priestess.name: Major Magical Research
priestess.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

priestess.name: Supreme Magical Research
priestess.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual divine spells and craft magical constructs; if chaotic, can create necromantic servants and become undead.

shaman.name: Commune with Spirits
shaman.summary: Once/week, a 1-turn helpless trance: ancestral or local spirits answer 3 yes/no questions; twice as many once a year on a sacred day.

shaman.name: Divine Magic
shaman.summary: Casts divine spells from his tradition's repertoire; spells per day by level follow the Shaman Spell Progression table (up to 6th level spells).

shaman.name: Tribal Traditions
shaman.summary: Auto-identifies symbols, spell signatures and holy days of his tribe, other faiths on 11+; may gain congregants (one rank of Theology).

shaman.name: Totem Animal
shaman.summary: Loyal, talking totem companion with HD = level-1 (1/2 at 1st), 4 hp/HD; grants its bonus proficiency within 30'. If slain, save vs Death or take its max hp.

shaman.name: Code of Behavior
shaman.summary: Show tribal holy symbol, dusk offerings (1 hr, 1cp), uphold totem's virtues, no foreign weapons, no magic harming tribe or called animals; else penalties.

shaman.name: Spiritual Ritual
shaman.summary: 1-hour ecstatic ritual regains one expended spell of a level; repeatable, but each spell level can be regained only once per day.

shaman.name: Minor Magical Research
shaman.summary: Can scribe scrolls and brew potions.

shaman.name: Shapechanging
shaman.summary: Shapechange into totem animal (its move, AC, attacks; keeps own HD, hp, throws): 1/day at 5th, +1/day per level. Action in lieu of movement; not dispellable.

shaman.name: Spiritwalking
shaman.summary: After 1 turn of chanting, enters a trance and his spirit walks free in human or totem form, as the spell spiritwalk; once per week.

shaman.name: Major Magical Research
shaman.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

shaman.name: Medicine Lodge
shaman.summary: With a 15,000gp+ lodge (half price if in favor), attracts 5d6x10 0th level tribesmen and 1d6 1st level shamans; loyalty +4, morale +4; must be paid.

shaman.name: Supreme Magical Research
shaman.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual divine spells and craft magical constructs.

warlock.name: Arcane Magic
warlock.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire sized by the Warlock Spell Progression table plus his INT bonus (up to 6th level spells).

warlock.name: Dark Path
warlock.summary: Chooses demonology, necromancy or transmogrification; the path grants a power at 1st level and again at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th and 11th level.

warlock.name: Occultism
warlock.summary: On 11+, names chthonic powers' titles and symbols, identifies undead types, and recalls demonology/necromancy lore (one rank of Knowledge (Occult)).

warlock.name: Demonology path: Conjure Dark Powers
warlock.summary: Summoning spells and research at +2 caster levels; Spells save to keep concentration when hurt; +2 research throws, +10% rate for summoning magic.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Secrets of the Dark Arts
warlock.summary: Controls undead as Chaotic crusader of half level; death spells give -2 saves; death/necromancy spells, research +2 caster levels, +2 throws, +10% rate.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Grotesque Arts of Transformation
warlock.summary: Transmogrification spells at +2 caster levels, targets -2 to saves; crossbreed/transmog research at +2 levels, +2 throws, +10% rate.

warlock.name: Corrupting Weakness
warlock.summary: Drawback: afflicted by a corrupting weakness (Judge picks or roll 1d10, e.g. Disfigured, Haunted, Nocturnal) at 1st and again at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th.

warlock.name: Demonology path: Theology
warlock.summary: Becomes a cultist of the chthonic powers; gains one rank of Theology proficiency.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Mortuary Science
warlock.summary: Deep study of anatomy and vitality; gains one rank of Healing proficiency.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Alchemy
warlock.summary: Gains one rank of Alchemy proficiency.

warlock.name: Demonology path: Conjure Hellion
warlock.summary: Pacts with demon lords let him cast conjure hellion once per day.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Speak with Dead
warlock.summary: Can cast speak with dead once per day.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Skinchange
warlock.summary: Can cast skinchange once per day.

warlock.name: Minor Magical Research
warlock.summary: Can research spells, scribe magical scrolls, and brew potions.

warlock.name: Demonology path: Expanded Repertoire
warlock.summary: +1 repertoire slot at each spell level he can cast; the extra spells must be conjuration or summoning spells, learned or researched separately.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Expanded Repertoire
warlock.summary: +1 repertoire slot at each spell level he can cast; the extra spells must be death or necromancy spells, learned or researched separately.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Expanded Repertoire
warlock.summary: +1 repertoire slot at each spell level he can cast; the extra spells must be transmogrification spells, learned or researched separately.

warlock.name: Demonology path: Words of Command and Obedience
warlock.summary: Summoned creatures obey him faithfully instead of twisting his intent; conjured creatures depart without harming him if his concentration breaks.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Lordship Over the Undead
warlock.summary: Undead he controls stay controlled 1 day/level instead of 1 turn/level; results that would give 1 day/level become indefinite control.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Hideous Servant
warlock.summary: Gains a bonded servant like a shaman's totem animal, taking two traits each from two animals; base HD is their average; no totem benefit.

warlock.name: Major Magical Research
warlock.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

warlock.name: Sanctum
warlock.summary: With a 15,000gp+ sanctum, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd level and 2d6 0th level apprentices in 1d3 months to aid research; a dungeon nearby draws monsters.

warlock.name: Demonology path: Power of Sacrifice
warlock.summary: Arcane power from blood sacrifice counts double its gp value and can be stored indefinitely, even when not researching.

warlock.name: Necromancy path: Secrets of Life and Death
warlock.summary: Performs necromancy at half the usual material cost and research cost.

warlock.name: Transmogrification path: Shape Flesh and Bone
warlock.summary: Creates magical crossbreeds at half the usual material cost and research cost.

warlock.name: Supreme Magical Research
warlock.summary: Can learn and cast 7th-9th level ritual arcane spells, craft constructs and create crossbreeds; if chaotic, can make necromantic servants and become undead.

witch.name: Studious Divine Magic
witch.summary: Casts divine spells learned by study, using mage progression and rules; keeps divine spell books, learns from scrolls/other divine books; no arcane spells.

witch.name: Tradition
witch.summary: Belongs to a tradition (Antiquarian, Chthonic, Sylvan). Gains congregants; IDs own faith's symbols, 11+ others (1 rank Theology). Tradition power at 1/3/5/7.

witch.name: Village Wisdom
witch.summary: Minor hedge magic for village life (ease colds, childbirth pains, remove pests); 1 turn per use. With optional cantrip rules, casts divine cantrips.

witch.name: Antiquarian: Traditional Medicine
witch.summary: Forage/ID healing herbs as Naturalism (+4 if has it), use as Healing. 1 turn + equal gp components: potent herbs +1 effect, last 24 hours.

witch.name: Chthonic: Bedazzling Glamour
witch.summary: 1 turn to activate glamour: +1 reactions (no stack with Mystic Aura), no age CHA penalty, ignores wound reaction penalties. Lasts until ended/dispelled.

witch.name: Sylvan: Friend of Birds and Beasts
witch.summary: ID plants/fauna 11+ (7+ w/ Beast Friendship), understands animals, +2 reactions with normal animals, takes and trains animal henchmen.

witch.name: Code of Behavior
witch.summary: Obligations to the powers: 1 at 1st, +1 per new spell level (3rd/5th/7th/9th/11th), ever more severe; breaking one brings Judge-set penalties until atoned.

witch.name: Brew Potions
witch.summary: Can brew potions; cannot yet research spells or scribe scrolls.

witch.name: Antiquarian: Healing Arts
witch.summary: Gains one rank of Healing proficiency (or Alchemy/Naturalism if already at 3 ranks of Healing).

witch.name: Chthonic: Decadent Arts
witch.summary: Gains Seduction proficiency (or Diplomacy or Intimidation if she already has Seduction).

witch.name: Sylvan: Natural Arts
witch.summary: Gains Naturalism proficiency (or second rank, Alchemy, or Healing if she already has it).

witch.name: Minor Magical Research
witch.summary: Can research new spells; cannot yet scribe scrolls.

witch.name: Antiquarian: Second Sight
witch.summary: Sees innately or magically invisible creatures within 60'. They know she can see them. Does not see through cover or darkness.

witch.name: Chthonic: Subtle Beguilement
witch.summary: Enchantment spells count as Quiet Magic (or no gestures if she has it); targets save at -2, or -3 with Mastery of Enchantments & Illusions.

witch.name: Sylvan: Close Friend of Birds and Beasts
witch.summary: Speak with beasts at will. Friendly reaction from small cute animals (songbirds, squirrels) makes them act as if bewitched.

witch.name: Scribe Scrolls
witch.summary: Can create magic scrolls.

witch.name: Antiquarian: Magic Mirror
witch.summary: Cast scry once/day via a mirror or reflective surface (1 turn); can add clairaudiency or telepathy from repertoire while scrying.

witch.name: Chthonic: Evil Eye
witch.summary: Bestow curse as a spell-like ability once per week; no need to declare before initiative and not disrupted by damage or failed saves.

witch.name: Sylvan: Enchanted Forest
witch.summary: Cast forest enchantment once per week (1 turn); can sustain one per caster level (about 2 acres per level).

witch.name: Witch's Cottage
witch.summary: With a 15,000gp+ cottage, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd level apprentices and 2d6 0th-level apprentices within 1d3 months; they assist magic research.

witch.name: Major Magical Research
witch.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

witch.name: Supreme Magical Research
witch.summary: Learns and casts 7th-9th level ritual divine spells, crafts constructs; if chaotic, can create necromantic servants and become undead.

craftpriest.name: Attention to Detail
craftpriest.summary: +3 bonus on proficiency throws for all proficiencies learned (already factored into class abilities).

craftpriest.name: Crafting
craftpriest.summary: Master of one craft: 40gp of goods/month, supervises 2 journeymen and 4 apprentices; IDs masterworks/materials/artisans on 2+ (3 ranks Craft).

craftpriest.name: Rebuke Undead
craftpriest.summary: Rebukes undead as a crusader of his level (Crusader Rebuking table; skeletons 10+ at 1st); success affects 2d6 HD for 1 turn. Needs holy symbol of his relic.

craftpriest.name: Studious Divine Magic
craftpriest.summary: Casts divine spells learned by study, using mage progression and rules; keeps divine spell books, learns from scrolls/other divine books; no arcane spells.

craftpriest.name: Theology
craftpriest.summary: Can gain congregants; auto-IDs dwarven religious symbols, trappings, holy days; other faiths on 8+ (1 rank Theology).

craftpriest.name: Dwarf Tongues
craftpriest.summary: Speaks Common, Dwarvish, Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

craftpriest.name: Hardy
craftpriest.summary: Saving throw targets improved by 3 for Blast and by 4 for all other saves (already in the save table).

craftpriest.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
craftpriest.summary: +1 surprise underground; search/listen via Adventuring on 14+ (vs 18+), or +4 Searching / +2 Listening if proficient.

craftpriest.name: Code of Behavior
craftpriest.summary: Strictures: show holy symbol in public, sing hymns on holy days, use only dwarven weapons, recover/guard relics, no divine magic vs dwarves; breach = penalties.

craftpriest.name: Minor Magical Research
craftpriest.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

craftpriest.name: Major Magical Research
craftpriest.summary: Can create permanent magic items (weapons, rings, staffs) and magical constructs such as golems.

craftpriest.name: Vault
craftpriest.summary: With a 15,000gp+ vault, attracts (1d4+1)x10 dwarven mercenaries and 1d6 1st-3rd level craftpriests within 1d3 months; must pay them.

vaultguard.name: Manual of Arms
vaultguard.summary: IDs military gear/standards of own clan and vault; 11+ for others; fights as a regular in formed and loose units (1 rank Manual of Arms).

vaultguard.name: Dwarf Tongues
vaultguard.summary: Speaks Common, Dwarvish, Goblin, Gnome, and Kobold.

vaultguard.name: Hardy
vaultguard.summary: Saving throw targets improved by 3 for Blast and by 4 for all other saves (already in the save table).

vaultguard.name: Sensitivity to Rock and Stone
vaultguard.summary: +1 surprise underground; search/listen via Adventuring on 14+ (vs 18+), or +4 Searching / +2 Listening if proficient.

vaultguard.name: Battlefield Prowess
vaultguard.summary: Henchmen and mercenaries he personally leads get +1 morale; stacks with CHA and proficiency modifiers.

vaultguard.name: Vault
vaultguard.summary: With a 15,000gp+ vault, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level dwarven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay them standard rates.

nightblade.name: Acrobatics
nightblade.summary: Skill throw 18+ at 1st level (improves by level). +2 saves vs agility dangers, adds level to DEX for jumps, tumble past engaged foe (max 5 st enc).

nightblade.name: Backstabbing
nightblade.summary: +4 to hit vs vulnerable foes in melee or short-range missile; +1 damage die at 1st level, another at 5th, 9th, and 13th.

nightblade.name: Climbing
nightblade.summary: Skill throw 6+ at 1st level (improves by level). One throw per 100' climbed; failure means a fall. -5 at half combat speed, -10 at full.

nightblade.name: Hiding
nightblade.summary: Skill throw 19+ at 1st level (improves by level). Hide in cover/dim light/darkness; foes -2 surprise; can't be targeted, -4 to attack if located.

nightblade.name: Shadowy Senses
nightblade.summary: At combat/exploration speed, perceives as if carrying 30' radius dim light; can't read or see colors/faces. Fails if running, deafened, bright light.

nightblade.name: Sneaking
nightblade.summary: Skill throw 17+ at 1st level (improves by level). Silent movement; foes -2 surprise if out of sight. -5 above half combat speed, -10 running.

nightblade.name: Streetwise
nightblade.summary: May join an assassin's guild; can do hijinks; IDs criminal signs/slang of home city, 11+ for others (1 rank Streetwise).

nightblade.name: Attunement to Nature
nightblade.summary: +1 surprise in wilderness; search/listen via Adventuring on 14+ (vs 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if proficient.

nightblade.name: Connection to Nature
nightblade.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

nightblade.name: Elf Tongues
nightblade.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

nightblade.name: Arcane Magic
nightblade.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire at a slower progression (caster level 1 at 2nd, 9 at 11th); can cast in light or very light armor.

nightblade.name: Quiet Magic
nightblade.summary: Casts with minimal words and gestures; Listening throw needed to hear; must be fully bound and gagged to stop casting.

nightblade.name: Minor Magical Research
nightblade.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as a 5th-level mage.

nightblade.name: Hideout
nightblade.summary: With a 5,000gp+ hideout, attracts 2d6 1st-level elven nightblades within 1d4 weeks (one is a rival's spy); can found a syndicate.

spellsword.name: Arcane Magic
spellsword.summary: Learns and casts arcane spells from a repertoire (spells per table + INT bonus); can cast while wearing armor.

spellsword.name: Collegiate Wizardry
spellsword.summary: May join a wizard's guild; auto-IDs arcane symbols, spell signatures, grimoires of own order; others on 11+ (1 rank Collegiate Wizardry).

spellsword.name: Attunement to Nature
spellsword.summary: +1 surprise in wilderness; search/listen via Adventuring on 14+ (vs 18+), or +2 Searching / +4 Listening if proficient.

spellsword.name: Connection to Nature
spellsword.summary: Immune to undead-caused diseases; +1 to Paralysis and Spells saves; +1 to 1st-level HD roll (already in tables).

spellsword.name: Elf Tongues
spellsword.summary: Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

spellsword.name: Minor Magical Research
spellsword.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

spellsword.name: Major Magical Research
spellsword.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

spellsword.name: Fastness
spellsword.summary: With a 15,000gp+ fastness in a natural setting, attracts 3d6x10 1st-level elven mercenaries within 1d3 months; must pay them.

wonderworker.name: Arcane Magic
wonderworker.summary: Learns and casts arcane spells as a mage from a repertoire (per Arcane Spell Progression table + INT bonus).

wonderworker.name: Collegiate Wizardry
wonderworker.summary: May join a wizard's guild; auto-IDs arcane symbols, spell signatures, grimoires of own order; others on 11+ (1 rank Collegiate Wizardry).

wonderworker.name: Divine Magic
wonderworker.summary: Also casts divine spells granted by prayer, per Divine Spell Progression table, using a crusader's repertoire for his faith.

wonderworker.name: Divine Health
wonderworker.summary: Immune to all disease, including magical diseases from spells, mummies, or lycanthropes.

wonderworker.name: Lay on Hands
wonderworker.summary: Once per day, heals 2 damage per class level by touch; Laying on Hands proficiency adds uses (1 rank Laying on Hands).

wonderworker.name: Blood of Ancient Kings
wonderworker.summary: Can hire one more henchman than CHA allows; henchmen base loyalty +1.

wonderworker.name: Favor of the Empyrean Powers
wonderworker.summary: +2 bonus to all saving throws (already in the save table).

wonderworker.name: Longeval
wonderworker.summary: No aging penalties, lifespan 3x normal; +1 to 1st-level HD roll; immune to undead-caused diseases.

wonderworker.name: Code of Behavior
wonderworker.summary: Must show holy symbol in public, pray at dawn and dusk (1 turn each), fight Chaos and uphold Law, never use divine magic for Chaotic ends; breach = penalties.

wonderworker.name: Minor Magical Research
wonderworker.summary: Can scribe scrolls, brew potions, and research arcane spells.

wonderworker.name: Major Magical Research
wonderworker.summary: Can create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

wonderworker.name: Sanctum
wonderworker.summary: With a 15,000gp+ sanctum, attracts 1d6 1st-3rd level and 2d6 0th-level apprentices within 1d3 months; a dungeon nearby draws monsters.

wonderworker.name: Supreme Magical Research
wonderworker.summary: Learns and casts 7th-9th level arcane and divine rituals, crafts constructs and crossbreeds; if chaotic, necromancy and undeath.

ruinguard.name: Dark Blessing
ruinguard.summary: +2 bonus to all saving throws (already in the save table).

ruinguard.name: Manual of Arms
ruinguard.summary: IDs military gear/standards of homeland; 11+ for other realms; fights as a regular in formed and loose units (1 rank Manual of Arms).

ruinguard.name: Preternatural Quickening
ruinguard.summary: +1 bonus to initiative and +1 bonus to avoid surprise.

ruinguard.name: Weapon Focus
ruinguard.summary: Gains Weapon Focus with one weapon type of choice: axes; maces, flails and hammers; or swords and daggers.

ruinguard.name: After the Flesh
ruinguard.summary: If made intelligent undead, keeps powers and advances HD without limit (3,500 XP to 2 HD +500 per *, doubling); abilities up to 14th.

ruinguard.name: Ancient Pacts
ruinguard.summary: +1 reactions with intelligent Chaotic monsters; they save at -2 vs his enchantment spells.

ruinguard.name: Dark Souls
ruinguard.summary: When dead and rolling on Tampering With Mortality, takes -1 per level of experience on the 1d20 roll.

ruinguard.name: Inexorable
ruinguard.summary: Immune to all natural and magical fear effects.

ruinguard.name: Zaharan Tongues
ruinguard.summary: Speaks Ancient Zaharan, Common, Goblin, Orc, and Kemeshi.

ruinguard.name: Arcane Magic
ruinguard.summary: Casts arcane spells from a repertoire at a slower progression (caster level 1 at 2nd, 9 at 11th); can cast in any armor.

ruinguard.name: Arcane Striking
ruinguard.summary: After a melee hit, expend a spell slot for +1d6 damage per slot level (arcane damage); a kill allows a cleave.

ruinguard.name: Death Healing
ruinguard.summary: On felling a sentient foe in melee, expend a spell slot to heal 1d6 per slot level, max the victim's starting hp; can still cleave.

ruinguard.name: Dark Charisma
ruinguard.summary: Chaotic characters and monsters in his service get +1 morale when he personally leads them; stacks with CHA and proficiencies.

ruinguard.name: Minor Magical Research
ruinguard.summary: Can research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as a 5th-level mage.

ruinguard.name: Dark Fortress
ruinguard.summary: With a 15,000gp+ dark fortress, attracts 5d6x10 0th-level or beastman troops and 1d6 1st-3rd level ruinguards in 1d3 months; must pay them.

ruinguard.name: Spell Storing
ruinguard.summary: Casts a creature-targeted spell into his melee weapon; discharges on next hit; one at a time, lasts 1 turn. A kill by it allows no cleave.

ruinguard.name: Major Magical Research
ruinguard.summary: Can create more powerful magic items (weapons, rings, staffs) as a 9th-level mage.
